articles.titleCn: 相同问题，不同领域：跨域解决方案导入——领域剥离计算指纹
articles.abstractCn: 在无关领域中，相同的底层计算问题在不同的名称下被解决：递归贝叶斯状态估计在控制领域表现为“卡尔曼滤波器”，在药代动力学领域表现为“贝叶斯预测”，在地球科学领域表现为“数据同化”。主题和基于引用的科学嵌入无法识别这一共享问题。我们将每篇论文一次性提炼成一个去除领域和方法名称的方面计算指纹，这是一个自由文本机制骨架加上受控计算方面。我们定义了一个可调节的、可选择的方面距离。目标是解决方案导入：表面跨领域成对解决相同问题，以便为另一个领域的标准、专业求解器替换定制实现。在一个包含109篇论文、18种方法族的基准测试中，骨架将跨领域检索的平均精度从摘要的0.222提升到0.513，整个指纹达到了0.557。引人注目的是，四个训练好的科学嵌入器都低于纯摘要+TF-IDF：它们编码主题和引用相似性，这是此任务的错误信号。收益在于表示：摘要到骨架的替换提升了每个嵌入器，并且该流程是每篇论文一个缓存的LLM调用加上一个廉价的嵌入器。一个干预性重新包装/数学编辑测试表明，指纹跟踪的是计算，而不是领域。在一个501篇论文的野生语料库中，已知成对论文主导了排名的前30位（前30位中有23对）；排除植入的对后，三个盲目的LLM评委评定前5位中有3对、前30位中有8对是真正的导入候选对，而随机对中没有一个。人工验证是执行的四个导入：其中一次，一个开放标准求解器重现了一个定制临床剂量引擎的输出。我们发布了基准测试、代码和提炼提示。

articles.title: Large-Scale User Behavior Analysis in Multimodal AI-Assisted Manual Task Execution
articles.abstract: Conversational Task Assistants (CTAs) are multimodal dialogue systems that support users in complex real-world tasks such as cooking and DIY through voice, text, image, and video interactions. Prior user studies have focused on controlled settings, leaving limited understanding of real-world CTA usage at scale. In this work, we present a large-scale study of CTA usage based on thousands of users in-the-wild. Our large-scale real-world data analysis unveils new understandings of (i) user-CTA interaction flows, (ii) user intents, (iii) user conversational traits, and (iv) behavioral factors associated with user satisfaction. Our findings reveal key opportunities for future research in CTAs, particularly in user interaction design and task engagement, concluding with concrete design guidelines.

articles.titleCn: 多模态AI辅助手动任务执行中的大规模用户行为分析
articles.abstractCn: 对话任务助手（CTAs）是一种支持用户通过语音、文本、图像和视频交互完成烹饪、DIY等复杂现实任务的多模态对话系统。以往的用户研究主要集中在受控环境中，对大规模现实世界CTA使用情况的理解有限。在这项工作中，我们基于野外环境中成千上万用户的大规模研究，呈现了CTA使用情况的研究。我们的大规模现实世界数据分析揭示了关于（i）用户-CTA交互流程、（ii）用户意图、（iii）用户对话特征以及（iv）与用户满意度相关的行为因素的新见解。我们的研究结果为CTA的未来研究提供了关键机会，特别是在用户交互设计和任务参与方面，并最终提出了具体的设计指南。

articles.title: Validating DBpedia Triple Sets for Natural Language Generation
articles.abstract: We present a study of the quality of individual DBpedia triples from the perspective of Natural Language Generation, and propose and evaluate an approach for collecting entity-specific triple sets that filters out questionable triples while minimizing the loss of correct ones. We show in an evaluation against manually annotated data that with validation rules, it is possible to reach 98% precision in triple selection, and with improvements to a few Property definitions, it is possible to improve recall by 40% without harming precision.

articles.titleCn: 验证DBpedia三元组集用于自然语言生成
articles.abstractCn: 我们从自然语言生成的角度，对个体DBpedia三元组的质量进行了研究，并提出并评估了一种收集特定实体三元组集的方法，该方法在尽可能减少正确三元组损失的同时，过滤掉可疑三元组。通过对人工标注数据的评估，我们证明了通过验证规则，三元组选择可以达到98%的精确度，并且通过改进几个属性定义，可以在不影响精确度的情况下将召回率提高40%。

articles.title: We're Cooked! - Probing LLM Political Alignment Via Conflict-Framed Recipe Translation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for translation tasks, yet their implicit political positioning in such contexts remains understudied. We ask whether a single politically charged framing term, such as aggressor, enemy, neighbour, or coloniser is sufficient to trigger implicit political alignment in an otherwise apolitical task. We present a fully crossed factorial study in which eight models spanning Western, Chinese, and European origins are prompted to translate culturally attributed recipes into a target language left deliberately unspecified. Across 17 languages, four framing conditions, eight models, and 15,680 responses, we find that models do not simply decline or ask for clarification but resolve the ambiguity. Language resolution and reasoning behavior cluster meaningfully along model families: Western models hedge and deflect with vague justifications, Chinese models resolve conflicts silently, and Mistral Large emerges as a distinct profile combining high compliance with conflict-grounded reasoning. Sensitivity to framing terms is consistent across models: even subtle framing variation is sufficient to modulate behavior. Our findings urge caution when deploying LLMs for translation in conflict-adjacent contexts, where implicit political judgments may be made without any signal to the user.
articles.titleCn: 我们完蛋了！——通过冲突框架下的食谱翻译探测大型语言模型的政治倾向
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于翻译任务，然而它们在这些情境中的隐含政治立场仍缺乏研究。我们探究单一具有政治色彩的概念词，如“侵略者”、“敌人”、“邻国”或“殖民者”，是否足以在原本非政治的任务中触发隐含的政治倾向。我们进行了一项完全交叉的实验研究，其中包含八个涵盖西方、中国和欧洲来源的模型，被提示将具有文化属性食谱翻译成故意不明确的目标语言。在涉及17种语言的四种框架条件、八个模型和15,680个回应中，我们发现模型不仅会拒绝或要求澄清，还会解决模糊性。语言解决和推理行为在模型家族中表现出有意义的聚集：西方模型用模糊的理由进行迂回和回避，中国模型无声地解决冲突，而Mistral Large呈现出独特的特征，结合了高服从性与基于冲突的推理。对框架词的敏感性在模型间是一致的：即使是微妙的框架变化也足以调节行为。我们的研究结果表明，在冲突边缘环境中部署LLMs进行翻译时应保持谨慎，因为在这种情况下可能会做出隐含的政治判断，而用户并未收到任何信号。

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR Technical Report
articles.abstract: In recent years, automatic speech recognition (ASR) has witnessed transformative advancements driven by three complementary paradigms: data scaling, model scaling, and deep integration with large language models (LLMs). However, bridging the gap between academic benchmark performance and real-world production utility remains a persistent challenge, particularly in handling diverse regional dialects, dynamic entities and hotwords, long-range contextual information, and disfluent spontaneous speech. In this report, we present Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM-based ASR system designed to address these production demands through a unified, instruction-following framework. The model is built upon the Qwen backbone, and is trained on tens of millions of hours of large-scale speech data. Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR supports transcription across 30 languages and 16 Chinese dialectal varieties spanning eight major dialect regions. Beyond multilingual and dialectal recognition, the model provides production-oriented capabilities including industry-domain entity recognition, hierarchical hotword customization, native single-pass transcription polishing, and long-audio contextual modeling. We further develop a dedicated streaming variant, Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Streaming, for latency-sensitive applications. Extensive evaluations on Chinese, English, multilingual, and real-world industrial test sets demonstrate state-of-the-art or highly competitive recognition performance across a broad range of evaluation conditions, with strong performance relative to leading commercial and proprietary systems including GPT-4o Transcribe and Gemini 3.1 Pro.

articles.abstractCn: 近年来，自动语音识别（ASR）在数据规模扩大、模型规模扩大以及与大语言模型（LLM）深度整合这三种互补范式驱动下取得了革命性进展。然而，弥合学术基准性能与实际生产应用之间的差距仍然是一个持续存在的挑战，特别是在处理多样化地域方言、动态实体和唤醒词、长距离上下文信息以及非流利自发性语音方面。在本报告中，我们提出了Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR，这是一个基于专家混合（MoE）LLM的ASR系统，旨在通过统一的指令遵循框架满足这些生产需求。该模型基于Qwen主干网络构建，并在数千万小时的大规模语音数据上进行训练。Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR支持30种语言和16种中国方言（涵盖八大主要方言区）的转录。除多语言和方言识别外，该模型还提供面向生产的应用能力，包括行业领域实体识别、层级式唤醒词定制、原生单次转录优化以及长音频上下文建模。我们进一步开发了一个专门的流式版本Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Streaming，用于对延迟敏感的应用。在中国、英语、多语言以及真实工业测试集上的大量评估表明，该模型在广泛的评估条件下展现出最先进或极具竞争力的识别性能，相对于领先的商业和专有系统（包括GPT-4o Transcribe和Gemini 3.1 Pro）表现出卓越的性能。

articles.title: Where Should Language Sit in a Multimodal Model? Lessons from What Language Does to Human Perception and Cognition
articles.abstract: Language models compute over tokens: language is their input, their output, and increasingly their internal representation. Whether language should keep all of these positions depends on what language does to the system that uses it. The one system with a century of data on that question is the human. We review what language does to human perception, the brain, and thought, and read the same evidence against multimodal models and language models. Throughout, we treat language as a compressor that runs on a shared codebook: a word is an index, the content is in the receiver, and a community maintains the codebook. In humans the compression is measurable, learning the codebook reorganizes the senses, and thought survives the loss of language. We then measure the rule that models apply when two cues disagree, with cue-conflict experiments on six vision-language models and two robot policies. Surviving cues are weighted in the order their reliabilities prescribe, at 11 to 82\% of the ideal observer's slope, and many answers copy the text. One policy family drops a cue that adds no information beyond the others rather than down-weighting it, another keeps it at a weight that fails when the cues conflict, and a visual cue that identifies the task in every training frame is never learned, because the language pathway already fits the data. Language models are the best current models of the human language network, and they have entered the human speech community, shifting word frequencies while alignment narrows their conceptual diversity. We close with seven implications for token-based systems. Language belongs at a model's boundary and in the shared codebook, as in the brain, not as its internal representation; the price of leaving the codebook inside is auditability.
articles.titleCn: 多模态模型中语言应置于何处？来自语言对人类感知和认知的影响的启示
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型在符号上进行计算：语言是它们的输入、输出，并且越来越多地成为它们的内部表示。语言是否应保持所有这些位置取决于语言对使用它的系统的影响。唯一拥有一个世纪关于这个问题的数据系统是人类。我们回顾语言对人类感知、大脑和思维的影响，并从多模态模型和语言模型的角度解读相同证据。在整个过程中，我们将语言视为一个在共享码本上运行的压缩器：一个词是一个索引，内容存在于接收者中，一个社区维护着码本。在人类中，压缩是可测量的，学习码本重组了感官，思维在失去语言后仍然存在。然后我们测量模型在两个线索冲突时应用的规则，通过六种视觉语言模型和两种机器人策略的线索冲突实验。幸存的线索按照其可靠性规定的顺序加权，达到理想观察者斜率的11%到82%，许多答案复制了文本。一个策略系列选择放弃其他线索之外不增加信息的线索，而不是降低其权重；另一个策略在线索冲突时保持其权重，导致失败；在每一帧训练中都识别任务的视觉线索从未被学习，因为语言通路已经适配了数据。语言模型是人类语言网络的当前最佳模型，它们已经进入了人类言语社区，在调整词频的同时，通过一致性缩小了它们的概念多样性。我们以七个基于符号系统的启示结束。语言应位于模型的边界和共享码本中，就像在大脑中一样，而不是作为其内部表示；将码本留在内部的价格是可审计性。

articles.title: MEMO: Multimodal Evidence Memory Organization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Long-running LLM agents rely on external memory to store and reuse information beyond a single context window, yet there is a fundamental tension between the continuous accumulation of interaction trajectories and the limited context capacity. The key challenge in agent memory is therefore not only to retrieve relevant records, but also to select necessary evidence under a given budget and organize it in an appropriate modality. Existing memory readout methods mainly use textual or visual forms. Text preserves high fidelity, but its linear token representation makes contents with different importance compete for the limited context at nearly uniform unit cost. Visual readout renders text into document-like images, which can use two-dimensional layouts to expose structure and emphasize key information, but it may lose fine-grained details during rendering and compression. To address this issue, we propose MEMO, a multimodal evidence memory organization method for LLM agents. MEMO first uses a trained evidence extractor to select relevant memory blocks and form evidence units with source information and presentation requirements. A trained query-conditioned memory manager assigns each unit to a textual, visual, or dual-channel carrier and selects a layout that matches the evidence structure. A deterministic memory construction module then generates the textual package and visual pages. The memory manager is trained with feedback from an offline reader that measures the utility of the guided memory plan, so that retention and presentation decisions align with downstream usage. We evaluate MEMO on four benchmarks, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, LoCoMo, and ALFWorld, with multiple reader backends. The results show that MEMO presents memory more efficiently with fewer memory tokens, improves downstream task performance, and builds more effective working memory under constrained budgets.

articles.titleCn: 备忘录：多模态证据记忆组织，用于长时程大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 长时间运行的LLM代理依赖于外部存储器来存储和重用单个上下文窗口之外的信息，然而交互轨迹的持续积累与有限的上下文容量之间存在根本性的矛盾。因此，代理存储的关键挑战不仅在于检索相关记录，还在于在给定预算下选择必要证据，并以适当的模式组织这些证据。现有的存储读取方法主要使用文本或视觉形式。文本保留了高保真度，但其线性标记表示使得不同重要性的内容几乎以相同的单位成本竞争有限的上下文。视觉读取将文本渲染成类似文档的图像，可以利用二维布局来展示结构并强调关键信息，但在渲染和压缩过程中可能会丢失细粒度细节。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MEMO，一种用于LLM代理的多模态证据存储组织方法。MEMO首先使用一个训练好的证据提取器来选择相关的存储块，并形成包含源信息和呈现要求的证据单元。一个训练好的查询条件存储管理器将每个单元分配给文本、视觉或双通道载体，并选择与证据结构匹配的布局。然后，一个确定性存储构建模块生成文本包和视觉页面。存储管理器通过一个离线读取器进行训练，该读取器测量引导存储计划的效用，以便保留和呈现决策与下游使用保持一致。我们在四个基准测试上评估了MEMO，包括HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、LoCoMo和ALFWorld，并使用了多个读取后端。结果表明，MEMO使用更少的存储标记更有效地呈现存储内容，提高了下游任务性能，并在受限预算下构建了更有效的工 作记忆。

articles.title: FramingQA: Does the Question Shape the Answer? Measuring the Compositional Framing Effect
articles.abstract: We introduce FramingQA, a benchmark that measures the model sensitivity to question framing across law, medicine, finance, and robotic simulations. Large language models (LLMs) often change their responses to subtle rephrasings that align with an implied stance by users. This can leave users with advice tainted by how they happened to phrase a question rather than by the underlying facts, and the consequences are highly costly in high-stakes domains. Because in the realistic scenarios, both expert practitioners and non-expert users frequently ask LLMs questions containing incomplete or misleading assumptions, models are highly susceptible to those framings. To test this, we inject the framing bias across three nested levels: a framing-biased question phrasing (root), an injected framing-biased premise prepended to a neutral question (propositional), and a premise paired with a framing-biased question (global). Evaluating nine open models (3.8B-70B) across four families, we find that strong per-variant accuracy does not guarantee the robustness across differently phrased questions under the fixed factual information.
articles.titleCn: FramingQA：问题是否塑造了答案？测量组合式框架效应
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了FramingQA，一个用于衡量模型在法律、医学、金融和机器人模拟等领域对问题措辞敏感度的基准。大型语言模型（LLMs）常常会根据用户隐含立场对细微的措辞变化做出响应调整。这可能导致用户得到的建议受到提问方式的影响，而非基于事实本身，在高风险领域中，其后果可能非常严重。由于在现实场景中，专家和普通用户都会向LLMs提出包含不完整或误导性假设的问题，因此模型很容易受到这些措辞的影响。为了测试这一点，我们在三个嵌套层级中注入了措辞偏差：一个带有措辞偏差的问题措辞（根本层），一个注入了措辞偏差的前提附加到一个中性问题上（命题层），以及一个前提与带有措辞偏差的问题配对（全局层）。在评估四个家族中的九个开放模型（3.8B-70B）后，我们发现，即使单个变体的准确率很高，也不能保证在固定事实信息下，模型对不同措辞问题的鲁棒性。

articles.title: An LLM-Associated Register Shift in Korean Journal Abstracts: A Morphology-Aware Excess-Vocabulary Study, 2018-2026
articles.abstract: Excess vocabulary, a word's frequency above its pre-2023 trend, is how the change in scholarly English after 2022 has been measured. We adapt it to Korean with morphological units on 398,296 KCI abstracts (2018-August 2026), with 47,165 Vietnamese abstracts for comparison. Placebo floors are 0.1-2.2 points for the single-word statistic and at most 2.9 for the re-selected split-half set statistic. Korean abstracts show nothing in 2023, onset in late 2024, a rise through 2025 flattening in mid-2026: sisahada "suggest" appears in 21.4% of 2026 abstracts against 5.3% expected; plain verbs like araboda "look into" fall to a quarter of trend. Under stated assumptions the single-word conditional lower bound on LLM-processed abstracts is 3.5%, 10.5% and 16.1% for 2024-2026 and a split-half set bound 7.8%, 20.6% and 33.0%. Holzwarth et al.'s estimator under the same discipline gives 41.9% and 72.1% for 2025-2026. Subject-matter controls reduce but do not remove it: restricting the set to lemmas three language-model annotators all call style leaves 14.7 of the 33.0 points, and pairing each 2026 abstract with its journal's closest base-period abstract leaves 34.1. Tested translation routes do not explain it: the surface marks of translated Korean fall as the markers rise. In the same articles' English abstracts the excess appears a year earlier; where the English side carries none, the Korean shift persists at 30 to 66% of the rate where it does. Control abstracts from three providers reproduce the rising words, with marker turnover consistent with model generations; implied prevalences are scenario-dependent.

articles.titleCn: 韩国期刊摘要中与大型语言模型相关的注册词移位：一种形态感知的超词汇研究，2018-2026
articles.abstractCn: 超额词汇，即2023年之前频率趋势以上的单词使用量，是衡量2022年后学术英语变化的方式。我们将其应用于韩语，基于398,296篇KCI摘要（2018年-2026年8月）进行形态单元分析，并使用47,165篇越南语摘要进行对比。单词统计的安慰剂基线为0.1-2.2分，重新选择的二分法统计基线最多为2.9分。韩语摘要在2023年未见变化，于2024年末开始出现，2025年持续上升，2026年中期趋于平缓：sisahada“建议”一词在2026年摘要中出现率为21.4%，超出预期5.3%；普通动词如araboda“调查”的使用量降至趋势的四分之一。在所设假设下，经LLM处理的摘要的单词条件下限为2024-2026年的3.5%、10.5%和16.1%，二分法统计下限为7.8%、20.6%和33.0%。Holzwarth等人同一学科的估计值为2025-2026年的41.9%和72.1%。主题控制可减少但不消除这一现象：将集合限制为三位语言模型标注员均称为风格的基本词，保留33.0点中的14.7点；将每篇2026年摘要与其期刊最接近的基本期摘要配对，保留34.1点。测试的翻译路径无法解释这一现象：翻译韩语的外部标记随着标记的上升而下降。在相同文章的英语摘要中，超额现象提前一年出现；当英语部分无标记时，韩语变化仍持续在30%至66%的速率。来自三个提供者的控制摘要重现了上升的词汇，标记周转与模型生成一致；隐含的流行度依赖于情景。

articles.title: Beyond Single-Negative Preference: Multi-Negative DPO for LLM-Centric Historical Entity Linking
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise for historical entity linking, but preference optimization for this task is often formulated with only one negative candidate per training instance. This discards information from the remaining candidates retrieved for the same mention. We introduce multi-negative direct preference optimisation (MDPO), a reference-based pairwise objective that compares the correct entity with all valid rejected candidates associated with each mention. MDPO preserves the Bradley-Terry formulation of DPO while exploiting the complete candidate set through masked, length-normalised sequence scores. We evaluate MDPO on hipe-2020 and newseye, covering French, German, English, Swedish, and Finnish historical newspaper text. Experiments show that MDPO improves over supervised fine-tuning and single-negative DPO, with particularly strong gains for NIL mentions, semantic ambiguity, OCR noise, and historically difficult names. Further analyses disentangle candidate-generation and selection errors, showing that candidate retrieval remains a key bottleneck for end-to-end entity linking. These results demonstrate that incorporating all within-instance negative candidates is a simple and effective improvement for LLM-based historical entity linking.
articles.titleCn: 超越单负偏好：面向大模型中心的历史实体链接多负DPO
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在历史实体链接方面最近展现出潜力，但针对该任务的选择优化通常每个训练实例仅使用一个负候选样本。这会丢弃为同一提及检索到的其他候选样本的信息。我们引入了多负直接偏好优化（MDPO），这是一种基于参考的成对目标，它将正确实体与每个提及关联的所有有效拒绝候选样本进行比较。MDPO保留了DPO的Bradley-Terry公式，同时通过掩码长度归一化的序列分数利用完整的候选集。我们在hipe-2020和新seye数据集上评估了MDPO，涵盖了法语、德语、英语、瑞典语和芬兰语的历史报纸文本。实验表明，MDPO优于监督微调和单负DPO，尤其是在NIL提及、语义歧义、OCR噪声和历史难名方面取得了显著提升。进一步分析将候选生成和选择错误解耦，表明候选检索仍然是端到端实体链接的关键瓶颈。这些结果表明，将所有实例内负候选样本纳入考虑是一种简单而有效的改进方法，适用于基于LLM的历史实体链接。

articles.title: Beyond Fluent Generation: A CPU Reliability Benchmark for MCP-Style Tool Calling in Sub-2B Small Language Models for Edge Deployment
articles.abstract: Resource constrained single-board computers including Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson Nano, Arduino UNO Q, Orange Pi, and LattePanda motivate on-device small language model (SLM) agents that reduce cloud dependence, improve data locality, and tolerate intermittent connectivity. Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style tool invocation demands more than fluent generation: an agent must emit machine-readable JSON, select the correct tool, supply all required arguments, and avoid unintended actions. We establish a platform-agnostic CPU baseline by evaluating five open-weight models below two billion parameters Phi-1.5, Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat, Qwen2.5-0.5B, and Qwen2.5-1.5B on 100 prompts spanning weather retrieval, web search, calculation, email composition, and task creation, under greedy decoding and nucleus sampling. A recovery parser strips Markdown fences, extracts brace-delimited substrings, and scores parseability, tool-name correctness, argument completeness, and value agreement. Under this criterion, Qwen2.5-1.5B achieves 75% (greedy) and 79% (sampling); Qwen2.5-0.5B achieves 72% (greedy) but drops to 32% under sampling. Phi-1.5 scores 0%; Pythia and TinyLlama reach at most 7%. A strict post-hoc audit finds only 5 of 1,000 raw responses directly parseable as JSON, exposing near-total dependence on output recovery. A CPU resource probe shows Qwen2.5-1.5B requires 7,960 MiB and 30.782 s mean latency; Qwen2.5-0.5B uses 3,637 MiB and 10.627 s, revealing a reliability-resource trade-off for edge deployment. These results do not cover the named boards directly or a full MCP implementation. Safe deployment requires schema validation, constrained generation, least-privilege execution, and human escalation for consequential actions.
articles.titleCn: 超越流利生成：用于边缘部署的亚2B小型语言模型中MCP风格工具调用的CPU可靠性基准
articles.abstractCn: 资源受限的单板计算机，包括树莓派、英伟达Jetson Nano、Arduino UNO Q、橙皮派和LattePanda，推动了设备端小型语言模型（SLM）代理的发展，这些代理减少了云依赖、提高了数据本地性，并容忍了间歇性连接。模型上下文协议（MCP）风格的工具调用不仅要求流畅生成，代理还必须输出机器可读的JSON格式，选择正确的工具，提供所有必需的参数，并避免无意中的操作。我们通过在100个涵盖天气获取、网络搜索、计算、邮件撰写和任务创建的提示下，对参数量低于20亿的五款开源模型Phi-1.5、Pythia-1.4B、TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat、Qwen2.5-0.5B和Qwen2.5-1.5B进行贪婪解码和核采样评估，建立了一个平台无关的CPU基准。恢复解析器去除Markdown围栏，提取花括号分隔的子字符串，并评分解析能力、工具名正确性、参数完整性和值一致性。根据这一标准，Qwen2.5-1.5B在贪婪解码下达到75%，核采样下达到79%；Qwen2.5-0.5B在贪婪解码下达到72%，但在核采样下降至32%。Phi-1.5得分为0%；Pythia和TinyLlama最高仅达到7%。严格的后期审计发现，只有5个1000个原始响应可直接解析为JSON，暴露了几乎完全依赖输出恢复的情况。CPU资源探测显示，Qwen2.5-1.5B平均需要7,960 MiB内存和30.782秒延迟；Qwen2.5-0.5B使用3,637 MiB内存和10.627秒，揭示了边缘部署的可靠性与资源之间的权衡。这些结果不包括直接针对命名单板或完整的MCP实现。安全部署需要模式验证、约束生成、最小权限执行以及对于重大操作的升级。

articles.title: BlueprintAgent: Constraint-Triggered Targeted Revisits for Simulation-Ready Generation from Scanned Structural Blueprints
articles.abstract: Converting in-service reinforced-concrete (RC) building blueprints into simulation-ready models---structured frame representations that support deterministic FEM export and qualified-engineer review---underpins safety assessment and seismic retrofit, but the process remains manual. Direct prompting of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) over a scanned sheet is unreliable: outputs often violate engineering constraints on beam--column support, span count, or 3D continuity. We present BlueprintAgent (BPA), a constraint-triggered multimodal agent for simulation-ready frame extraction from scanned blueprints. BPA treats the MLLM as the primary reader and decision maker, with OCR and computer vision supplying localized evidence. Its central mechanism realizes engineering constraints as callable validators whose entity-level conflict reports trigger targeted MLLM revisits over the local region---an inference-time control distinct from fixed pipelines and free-form self-reflection. We evaluate BPA on 300 real scanned blueprint sheets from 20 anonymized RC frame projects, against five baselines and six ablations. BPA reaches a macro-averaged Beam F1 of 0.994, against 0.301 for single-MLLM zero-shot and 0.820 for a fixed pipeline; removing MLLM-led axis adjudication collapses Beam and Column F1 on complex multi-sheet projects. For dense technical drawings, engineering constraints are best deployed as triggers for entity-level targeted revisits rather than as post-hoc output filters.

articles.titleCn: 蓝图智能体：基于约束触发的目标性重访，用于从扫描结构蓝图生成仿真准备好的输出
articles.abstractCn: 将现场使用的钢筋混凝土（RC）建筑蓝图转换为可用于模拟的模型——即支持确定性有限元分析（FEM）导出和合格工程师审核的结构框架表示——是进行安全评估和抗震加固的基础，但该过程仍然依赖人工。直接在扫描的图纸上对多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）进行提示是不可靠的：输出结果经常违反工程约束，例如梁柱支撑、跨度数量或三维连续性。我们提出了BlueprintAgent（BPA），这是一种基于约束触发的多模态代理，用于从扫描的蓝图中提取可用于模拟的结构框架。BPA将MLLM视为主要的阅读者和决策者，而光学字符识别（OCR）和计算机视觉则提供局部证据。其核心机制将工程约束实现为可调用的验证器，当实体验证报告冲突时，会触发MLLM针对局部区域进行有针对性的重新推理——这是一种与固定流程和自由形式的自我反思不同的推理时控制机制。我们在20个匿名RC框架项目中选取的300份真实扫描蓝图上对BPA进行了评估，与五个基线和六个消融实验进行了对比。BPA达到了宏观平均的梁F1分数0.994，而单MLLM零样本的梁F1分数为0.301，固定流程的梁F1分数为0.820；移除由MLLM领导的轴判定会导致复杂多图纸项目的梁和柱F1分数下降。对于密集的技术图纸，工程约束最好作为触发实体验证重新推理的机制，而不是作为事后输出过滤器。

articles.title: Content-Based Addressing for Long Context
articles.abstract: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) uses each token's integer position to determine the rotation applied inside attention. This works well for local token order, but increasing context length creates a positional train-test mismatch: RoPE produces relative rotations at offsets not seen during training. Methods that rescale, interpolate, randomize, or bias positions specify how attention handles those offsets, but still derive positional information from a growing token counter. We instead divide a token stream into units, retain ordinary RoPE positions within each unit, and assign every completed unit an address computed from its content. Adding units then applies the same learned map to new content rather than extending a positional range or an identifier table. We prove that this construction preserves local RoPE exactly, leaves the attention comparison between two fixed tokens unchanged when other units are inserted or reordered, and does not create new relative rotations merely because more units are added. In a character-level Tiny Shakespeare diagnostic, a model trained on 256-character contexts has validation perplexity 4.04 at 256 characters and 3.82 at 4096, while continuous RoPE changes from 4.71 to 12.09. A second diagnostic shows that content-based addressing can retrieve and use information from multiple serialized facts. These are controlled shallow experiments, not scale benchmarks, but they support a direct prescription: use position to address locally and content to address across units.
articles.titleCn: 基于内容的寻址技术用于长上下文
articles.abstractCn: 旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）使用每个token的整数位置来确定注意力机制内部的旋转。这种方法对于局部token顺序效果良好，但增加上下文长度会产生位置训练-测试不匹配问题：RoPE在训练中未见的偏移量上产生相对旋转。那些重新缩放、插值、随机化或偏置位置的方法指定了注意力如何处理这些偏移量，但仍然从不断增长的token计数器中提取位置信息。我们则将token流划分为单元，在每个单元内保留常规的RoPE位置，并为每个完成的单元分配一个根据其内容计算出的地址。添加单元时，将应用相同的已学习映射到新内容，而不是扩展位置范围或标识符表。我们证明这种结构精确地保留了局部RoPE，在插入或重新排序其他单元时，两个固定token之间的注意力比较保持不变，并且仅仅因为添加了更多单元而不会产生新的相对旋转。在一个字符级的Tiny Shakespeare诊断中，一个在256字符上下文中训练的模型在256字符时的验证困惑度为4.04，在4096字符时为3.82，而连续RoPE则从4.71变化到12.09。第二个诊断表明，基于内容的寻址可以检索和使用来自多个序列化事实的信息。这些是受控的浅层实验，而非规模基准，但它们支持一个直接的建议：使用位置进行局部寻址，使用内容进行跨单元寻址。

articles.title: LANTERN: Language Model Assessment on Noisy and Transformed Tasks for Understanding Error and Robustness Nuances
articles.abstract: Robustness evaluation of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge, particularly in assessing their sensitivity to perturbations in input data. In this work, we systematically evaluate LLM robustness across multiple dimensions, including word error rate, character repetition and duplication, modifications in choices, and variability in instruction following. To facilitate this evaluation, we construct a synthetic and augmented dataset encompassing a diverse set of LLM benchmarks, specifically targeting multiple-choice question (MCQ) datasets and instruction-following tasks. We conduct extensive experiments on LLMs of varying scales-small, medium, and large-as well as across base and instruction-tuned variants. Our analysis quantifies the variability in model responses under perturbed conditions and highlights discrepancies relative to baseline models. The findings provide insights into the stability of LLMs across different evaluation scenarios contributing to the development of more robust and reliable language models as well as robust evaluation methodologies.
articles.titleCn: 用于在噪声和转换任务上评估语言模型的错误和鲁棒性细微差别的灯笼
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的鲁棒性评估仍然是一个关键挑战，特别是在评估其对输入数据扰动的敏感性方面。在本工作中，我们系统地从多个维度评估LLMs的鲁棒性，包括单词错误率、字符重复和重复、选项修改以及指令遵循的变异性。为了促进这一评估，我们构建了一个合成和增强的数据集，其中包含多样化的LLMs基准，特别针对多项选择题（MCQ）数据集和指令遵循任务。我们对不同规模的LLMs（小型、中型和大型）以及基础模型和指令微调变体进行了广泛的实验。我们的分析量化了模型在扰动条件下的响应变化，并突出了与基线模型之间的差异。这些发现为LLMs在不同评估场景下的稳定性提供了见解，有助于开发更鲁棒和可靠的语言模型以及鲁棒的评估方法。

articles.title: SPARROW: Scalable Taxonomy Induction via Structure-Preserving Partitioning and Constraint-Guided Merging
articles.abstract: Taxonomy induction aims to organize concept sets into coherent hierarchical structures. Recent LLM-based methods can induce taxonomies directly from flat term lists, avoiding the need for corpora, but degrade sharply as concept sets scale up. We argue that this degradation stems not only from context length limitations, but also from structural failures in hierarchical reasoning. To address this, we adopt a divide-and-merge paradigm that partitions concepts into smaller subsets, induces local taxonomies, and merges them into a global hierarchy. However, we identify two structural failure modes inherent to this paradigm: Structural Fragmentation, where partitioning weakens local hierarchical signals, and Parent Displacement, where locally plausible relations are misplaced in the global hierarchy. To address both, we propose SPARROW, a scalable taxonomy induction framework that combines structure-preserving spectral partitioning to retain hierarchical connectivity within each block, and constraint-guided incremental fusion that treats block-level relations as structural constraints rather than ground truth for global placement. Experiments on large-scale benchmarks show that SPARROW consistently achieves the strongest global structural quality across backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/rebeccazyr/SPARROW.

articles.titleCn: SPARROW：基于结构保持划分和约束引导合并的可扩展分类法归纳
articles.abstractCn: 分类归纳旨在将概念集组织成连贯的层次结构。近期的基于大型语言模型的方法可以直接从扁平术语列表中归纳分类，避免了语料库的需求，但在概念集规模扩大时性能急剧下降。我们认为这种退化不仅源于上下文长度限制，还源于层次推理中的结构缺陷。为解决这一问题，我们采用分而治之的范式，将概念划分为更小的子集，归纳局部分类，并将它们合并成一个全局层次结构。然而，我们识别出这种范式固有的两种结构失效模式：结构碎片化，即划分会削弱局部层次信号；以及父节点错位，即局部合理的关联在全局层次结构中被错误放置。为解决这两种问题，我们提出了SPARROW，一个可扩展的分类归纳框架，该框架结合了结构保持谱划分来保留每个块内的层次连接性，以及约束引导的增量融合，将块级关系视为结构约束而非全局放置的真实标注。在大型基准测试上的实验表明，SPARROW在骨干结构中始终能实现最强的全局结构质量。代码可在https://github.com/rebeccazyr/SPARROW获取。

articles.title: RouteRelay: Event-Triggered Cross-Layer Route Reuse for Efficient Dynamic Sparse Attention
articles.abstract: Dynamic sparse attention reduces long-context prefill cost by routing each query chunk to a small set of key chunks at every Transformer layer. The sparse attention kernel avoids most token interactions, but the router still rebuilds a chunk--chunk score matrix layer after layer, even when the selected routes change little. We introduce RouteRelay, a router-agnostic method that reuses only route metadata across depth while continuing to compute attention with the current layer's queries, keys, and values. Anchor layers perform full routing. Intermediate layers rescore the previous top-$k$ route and a compact sentinel set of near-miss and randomly probed chunks. A query row is rerouted only when a sentinel challenges its weakest selected chunk. We give a top-$k$ stability condition, a probabilistic bound on missed challengers, and a row-selective GPU execution design. In a reproducible empirical evaluation, RouteRelay retains at least 99.99% route recall while rerouting 25.0%, 55.4%, and 78.2% of rows under low, moderate, and high cross-layer drift, respectively. Across routing scales, RouteRelay retains 100.0% recall while evaluating 38.4--51.6% of full-routing score pairs as the key-chunk count grows from 128 to 1024. Its unfused CPU execution remains slower than dense matrix multiplication, exposing row compaction and ledger updates as the main kernel-engineering targets.
articles.titleCn: 路由中继：基于事件触发的跨层路由重用，实现高效动态稀疏注意力
articles.abstractCn: 动态稀疏注意力通过在每个Transformer层将每个查询块路由到一小部分键块来降低长上下文预填充成本。稀疏注意力核避免了大多数token交互，但路由器仍然逐层重建块-块分数矩阵，即使选择的路径变化很小也是如此。我们引入了RouteRelay，这是一种与路由器无关的方法，它在深度方向上仅重用路由元数据，同时继续使用当前层的查询、键和值计算注意力。锚层执行完整路由。中间层重新评估先前排名前k的路径以及一个紧凑的哨兵集，包括接近匹配和随机探测的块。只有当哨兵挑战其最弱选择的块时，查询行才会被重新路由。我们给出了一个排名前k的稳定性条件，一个关于遗漏挑战者的概率界限，以及一个行选择性的GPU执行设计。在一个可重复的实证评估中，RouteRelay在低、中、高跨层漂移情况下分别重新路由了25.0%、55.4%和78.2%的行，同时保持了至少99.99%的路径召回率。在路由规模范围内，随着键块数量从128增长到1024，RouteRelay保持了100.0%的召回率，同时将38.4--51.6%的完整路由分数对评估为键块。其未融合的CPU执行仍然比密集矩阵乘法慢，揭示了行压缩和账本更新作为主要的内核工程目标。

articles.title: Marginal Fidelity Does Not Establish User Simulation in Demographic Synthetic Survey Panels: Response Contracts, Support Collapse and Conditioning Failure
articles.abstract: Demographic synthetic survey panels are often validated by matching aggregate answers to published surveys. We test what that certificate establishes across six multiselect batteries from four survey organisations in three countries. The headline analysis is restricted to three instruments whose synthetic cohort and human target share the stated population frame; three other batteries remain sensitivity analyses. The response contract dominates measured fidelity. In the aligned instruments, committed sets leave 66 of 128 model-battery option slots empty in panels of up to 500 respondents, versus 0 of 128 under per-option probability elicitation. Across eight uncapped model-instrument comparisons, probabilities reduce option-marginal MAE by 4.53 to 7.30 points. The capped instrument reverses on two models until the vectors are projected onto its stated maximum. These are measurement effects: human targets are realised check-all responses, whereas the vectors are latent inclusion propensities. Published marginal agreement also fails to discriminate respondent simulation from direct population estimation. On nine aligned model-battery pairs, a no-persona population-prevalence query averages 6.27 MAE versus 12.39 for committed panels and wins all nine comparisons. Constraint-aware probability vectors average 5.34 and beat the query on four of nine, so the baseline challenges the validation criterion rather than proving direct estimation uniformly best. On three unpublished demographic cells, neither approach beats reciting the national distribution. Population-marginal agreement is therefore evidence about an elicitation contract and an estimand obtainable without simulated respondents, not evidence of individual simulation.

articles.titleCn: 边际保真度无法在人口合成调查样本中建立用户模拟：响应合同、支持崩溃与条件失效
articles.abstractCn: 人口统计合成调查样本通常通过将汇总答案与已发布的调查进行匹配来验证。我们测试了这一认证在三个国家的四个调查组织的六个多选电池中的有效性。主要分析仅限于三个仪器，这些仪器的合成队列和人类目标共享声明的总体框架；其余三个电池则作为敏感性分析。响应合同主导了测量的保真度。在匹配的仪器中，承诺集使最多500名受访者的样本中128个模型电池选项槽中有66个为空，而在按选项概率诱导的情况下则为0个。在八次无上限的模型仪器比较中，概率将选项边缘MAE降低了4.53至7.30个百分点。有上限的仪器在向量投影到其声明的最大值之前会反转两个模型。这些是测量效应：人类目标是实现的全部勾选响应，而向量是潜在的纳入倾向。已发布的边缘协议也无法区分受访者模拟与直接人口估计。在九对匹配的模型电池中，无个人身份的总体患病率查询平均MAE为6.27，而承诺面板为12.39，并在所有九次比较中胜出。约束感知概率向量平均为5.34，并在九次中的四次中击败查询，因此基线挑战了验证标准，而不是证明直接估计始终最佳。在三个未发布的统计单元中，两种方法都不及背诵国家分布。因此，总体边缘协议是关于诱导合同和无需模拟受访者即可获得的估计量，而不是个体模拟的证据。

articles.title: Probing the Structure and Dynamics of LLM Value Expression through Value Conflicts
articles.abstract: Ethical evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) often characterizes model values as static and monolithic. In contrast, we argue that LLM value expression is better understood as a structured yet dynamic phenomenon. To investigate this, we introduce Conflict-driven Value Probing, a controlled framework that places LLMs in value conflicts and implements four types of interventions that perturb these conflicts to probe LLM value expression. Applying this framework to ten LLMs, we identify three recurring patterns. (1) Expression duality: models shift from broad idealistic orientations in abstract assessment toward more pragmatic priorities in concrete conflicts. (2) Functional steerability: models readily reconfigure their expressed value profiles toward task-defined value objectives. (3) Bounded plasticity: such reconfiguration is not without constraints, i.e. pressure induces a security- and goal-oriented priority shift while negative framing distinguishes protected values from those more amenable to redirection. Together, these findings characterize both the structure and dynamics of LLM value expression: context flexibly reconfigures expressed priorities, yet within behavioral boundaries. This behavioral account provides a foundation for understanding controllability, alignment, and safety in LLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe.

articles.titleCn: 探究LLM价值表达的结构与动态：通过价值冲突
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型（LLMs）的伦理评估通常将模型价值观描述为静态且单一的。相比之下，我们认为LLM价值观的表达应被理解为一种结构化但动态的现象。为了研究这一点，我们引入了冲突驱动价值观探测（Conflict-driven Value Probing），这是一个可控框架，将LLMs置于价值观冲突中，并实施四种类型的干预措施来扰动这些冲突，以探测LLM价值观的表达。应用这一框架对十个LLMs进行分析，我们识别出三种反复出现的模式。(1) 表达双重性：模型在抽象评估中从广泛的理想主义倾向转变为具体冲突中的更务实优先事项。(2) 功能可引导性：模型容易根据任务定义的价值观目标重新配置其表达的价值特征。(3) 有界可塑性：这种重新配置并非没有限制，即压力会引发以安全和目标为导向的优先事项转变，而负面框架则能区分受保护价值观与更容易被重新定向的价值观。这些发现共同描绘了LLM价值观表达的结构和动态特征：上下文灵活地重新配置表达优先事项，但行为边界内保持稳定。这一行为解释为理解LLMs的可控性、对齐性和安全性提供了基础。代码和数据可在https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe获取。

articles.title: TAD: Token-Adaptive Contrastive Decoding with Confidence-Guided Gating for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Audio-Language Models
articles.abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can hallucinate audio objects, answering "yes" to absent sound events, thus undermining reliability in audio question answering. We propose Token-Adaptive Decoding (TAD), a training-free strategy for hallucination mitigation that grounds the initial yes/no decision by contrasting logits under real audio with a matched silent reference. TAD introduces a token-adaptive, confidence-guided gate that is decision-critical at the first decoding step and class-conditional on affirmative tokens, using the audio-silent margin to avoid overcorrection when evidence is weak or already sufficient. Experiments on AudioCaps-Hallucination show that, relative to Audio-Aware Decoding (AAD), a contrastive baseline with fixed contrast strength, TAD improves F1 for Qwen2 by 0.059 to 0.117 across Popular, Adversarial, and Random splits, and for Gemma by 0.025 to 0.064, while on Clotho-AQA it raises F1 from 0.810 to 0.816 on Qwen2 and remains comparable to AAD on Gemma.

articles.titleCn: TAD：基于置信度引导门控的标记自适应对比解码，用于大型音频语言模型的幻觉缓解
articles.abstractCn: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）能够产生虚假的音频对象，对缺失的声音事件回答“是”，从而损害了音频问答的可靠性。我们提出了Token-自适应解码（TAD），这是一种无需训练的幻觉缓解策略，通过将真实音频下的logits与匹配的静音参考进行对比来为初始的“是/否”决策提供依据。TAD引入了一个token自适应、置信度引导的门控机制，该机制在首次解码步骤中起决策关键作用，并且对肯定性token具有类别条件性，利用音频-静音边距来避免在证据微弱或已经足够时过度纠正。在AudioCaps-Hallucination上的实验表明，相对于具有固定对比强度的对比基线Audio-Aware Decoding（AAD），TAD在Popular、Adversarial和Random划分中提高了Qwen2的F1值0.059至0.117，提高了Gemma的F1值0.025至0.064，而在Clotho-AQA上，TAD将Qwen2的F1值从0.810提高到0.816，并且Gemma的表现与AAD相当。

articles.title: Separating Stream Stability from Long-Term Recall in Language Models
articles.abstract: Methods for streaming language models are often discussed alongside long-context and memory systems, although they solve different problems. An attention sink can stabilize autoregressive generation over an indefinitely long stream while the model remains unable to use content that has left its recent-token cache. We argue that this distinction should be explicit in system claims and evaluation. We introduce three horizons: the stability horizon, over which predictive behavior remains well behaved; the access horizon, over which past content can still causally affect the output; and the utility horizon, over which a task retains acceptable performance. We show constructively that the stability horizon can be infinite while the access and utility horizons are finite. We then propose ThreeH, an evaluation contract that measures all three horizons under a common state and compute budget. Applying the framework to attention-sink streaming clarifies its strength, constant-memory, stable generation, without treating anchor tokens as semantic memory. The framework exposes roles for cache policies, recurrent state, retrieval, and external memory. Experiments on 128K-token streams, delayed binding recall, and delayed decisions show that attention sinks preserve local modeling but not content beyond the active cache; recurrent and retrieval state extend the semantic horizon.
articles.titleCn: 将流稳定性与语言模型的长期记忆区分开来
articles.abstractCn: 流式语言模型的方法通常与长上下文和记忆系统一起讨论，尽管它们解决的是不同的问题。注意力池可以稳定无限长流中的自回归生成，而模型仍然无法使用已离开其近期令牌缓存的內容。我们认为，这一区别应在系统声明和评估中明确。我们引入了三个时间范围：稳定性范围，其中预测行为保持良好；访问范围，其中过去內容仍可因果地影响输出；以及效用范围，其中任务仍保持可接受性能。我们通过构造性证明，稳定性范围可以是无限的，而访问范围和效用范围是有限的。然后我们提出了ThreeH，一个评估协议，它在一个共同的状态和计算预算下测量这三个范围。将框架应用于注意力池流式处理，阐明了其优势：恒定内存、稳定生成，而不将锚点令牌视为语义记忆。该框架揭示了缓存策略、循环状态、检索和外部内存的作用。在128K令牌流、延迟绑定回忆和延迟决策的实验表明，注意力池保留局部建模但无法保留活动缓存之外的内容；循环和检索状态扩展了语义范围。

articles.title: CEDAR: Error-Bounded Residual Routing for Efficient Long-Context Attention
articles.abstract: Post-hoc sparse attention accelerates long-context prefill by routing each query to a small set of token-level interactions. Hard selection, however, assigns zero probability to every omitted chunk: a routing miss cannot be recovered, and a fixed expansion budget spends the same work on easy and ambiguous queries. We introduce Coarse-to-fine Error-aware Dynamic Attention Routing (CEDAR), a coarse-to-fine method that keeps the language model frozen while preserving global coverage. Each semantic chunk contributes a cheap key--value summary to a residual attention path; chunks with high estimated approximation error are then expanded to exact token attention. Exact and summarized contributions are combined in a single softmax normalization, so refinement replaces, rather than duplicates, coarse evidence. We derive an output-error bound governed by within-chunk key/value dispersion and use it to allocate a variable refinement budget. A controlled clustered-attention study shows that residual summaries reduce reconstruction error by more than 98% relative to hard dropping at equal exact-chunk budgets. Experiments on long-context benchmarks demonstrate that CEDAR recovers most of the quality lost by hard sparse routing while maintaining approximately $3\times$ kernel speedup at 128K context.
articles.titleCn: CEDAR：误差界限残差路由，用于高效长上下文注意力
articles.abstractCn: 后验稀疏注意力通过将每个查询路由到少量token级交互来加速长上下文预填充。然而，硬选择将每个被忽略的片段分配零概率：路由失败无法恢复，且固定的扩展预算对简单和模糊查询花费相同的工作量。我们引入了粗粒度到细粒度的误差感知动态注意力路由（CEDAR），这是一种在冻结语言模型的同时保持全局覆盖的粗粒度到细粒度方法。每个语义片段向残差注意力路径贡献一个廉价的键值摘要；然后，估计近似误差较高的片段被扩展为精确的token注意力。精确和摘要的贡献在单个softmax归一化中结合，因此细化替换了粗粒度证据，而不是重复它。我们推导出一个受片段内键/值分散度约束的输出误差界，并使用它来分配可变的细化预算。一项受控的集群注意力研究表明，与在相同精确片段预算下进行硬丢弃相比，残差摘要将重建误差降低了98%以上。在长上下文基准测试上的实验表明，CEDAR恢复了大部分由硬稀疏路由丢失的质量，同时在128K上下文中保持了约3倍的内核速度提升。

articles.title: KABURI-TTS: Phoneme-Keyed Activity-conditioned Bi-channel Utterance Rendering for Interaction
articles.abstract: Realizing full-duplex spoken dialogue requires large amounts of two-channel, one-speaker-per-channel conversational speech data. Although conversational text-to-speech (TTS) engines have been developed, they are not necessarily robust to two-party simultaneous phenomena such as backchannels, interruptions, and overlaps that occur while the interlocutor is speaking. In this work, aiming at conversational speech synthesis that reproduces human-like overlap, we propose KABURI-TTS. KABURI-TTS takes a per-speaker phoneme raster as input and renders the speech of the two speakers on separate channels, conditioned on the per-frame phonemes and the voice activity derived from them. Because the phoneme raster is supplied by a separate module, the proposed method enables controllable generation of one-speaker-per-channel, two-party spoken dialogue. A user evaluation shows that, compared with strong baselines, the proposed method attains higher naturalness at both the utterance and the interaction level. Furthermore, an analysis of voice activity confirms that the proposed method produces more overlap and more frequent turn-taking.
articles.comment: Accepted at APSIPA ASC 2026
articles.titleCn: KABURI-TTS：基于音素键控的活动条件双通道语音合成技术
articles.abstractCn: 实现全双工语音对话需要大量双通道、每通道一位说话人的对话语音数据。尽管已经开发了对话文本到语音（TTS）引擎，但它们在面对对话者同时说话时出现的回声、打断和重叠等现象时，并不一定具有鲁棒性。在这项工作中，为了实现能够再现类人重叠的对话语音合成，我们提出了KABURI-TTS。KABURI-TTS以每位说话人的音素光栅为输入，并在两个独立的通道上渲染两位说话人的语音，条件基于每帧的音素及其衍生的语音活动。由于音素光栅由单独的模块提供，所提出的方法能够实现每通道一位说话人的双人对话语音可控生成。用户评估表明，与强基线相比，所提出的方法在语句层面和交互层面都达到了更高的自然度。此外，语音活动分析证实，所提出的方法产生了更多的重叠和更频繁的轮流发言。

articles.title: SIFTING: A Novel LLM-Based Framework for Structured and Transparent Information Extraction from Clinical Free-Text Reports, with Application to Tumor Staging in Lung Cancer
articles.abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) show promise for extracting information from clinical free-text documents, but their outputs are often unstructured and lack traceability, complicating validation and adoption in clinical workflows. In this work we introduce SIFTING, an LLM-based framework designed to address these shortcomings. Methods: SIFTING combines the language comprehension capabilities of LLMs with segment-level processing and structured prompts with strict output control, linking findings to the source text to enable both accurate and transparent information extraction. To demonstrate its capabilities, we applied the framework to the task of extracting tumor T-stage information from 130 lung cancer radiology reports (SIFTING-T-stage). A compact 4-bit quantized version of the open-source LLM Llama-3.3-70B (35 GB) was used in a fully self-hosted setup, providing full control over data and model. Performance was evaluated against a reference standard created by four clinical experts and compared with a range of LLMs as used in a conventional single-prompt approach, using bootstrap resampling to estimate confidence intervals. Results: SIFTING-T-stage achieved an accuracy of 90% (95% CI: 84-95) against the reference standard. We found its performance to be comparable to even the largest state-of-the-art LLMs with reasoning capabilities and to be interchangeable with clinical experts (p < 0.001), while at the same time offering full traceability through source text references. Conclusion: SIFTING enables accurate, structured, and traceable information extraction from clinical free-text documents. It ensures data control, reproducibility, and verifiable outputs that can support clinical validation and workflow integration.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables
articles.titleCn: 筛选：一种基于大型语言模型的结构化透明信息提取新框架，应用于肺癌肿瘤分期
articles.abstractCn: 背景：大型语言模型（LLMs）在从临床自由文本文档中提取信息方面显示出潜力，但其输出通常结构化程度低且缺乏可追溯性，这给其在临床工作流程中的验证和采纳带来了挑战。在这项工作中，我们介绍了SIFTING，一个基于LLMs的框架，旨在解决这些不足。方法：SIFTING结合了LLMs的语言理解能力、分段级处理、结构化提示以及严格的输出控制，将结果与源文本链接起来，以实现准确且透明的信息提取。为了展示其能力，我们将该框架应用于从130份肺癌放射学报告中提取肿瘤T分期信息（SIFTING-T分期）。我们使用了一个紧凑的4位量化版本的开源LLM Llama-3.3-70B（35 GB），在一个完全自托管的设置中使用，从而对数据和模型拥有完全控制权。性能通过与由四位临床专家创建的参考标准进行评估，并与传统单提示方法中使用的各种LLMs进行比较，使用自举重采样来估计置信区间。结果：SIFTING-T分期对参考标准的准确率达到90%（95% CI：84-95）。我们发现其性能甚至可与具有推理能力的最先进的最大LLMs相媲美，并且可以与临床专家互换（p < 0.001），同时通过源文本引用提供完全的可追溯性。结论：SIFTING能够从临床自由文本文档中实现准确、结构化和可追溯的信息提取。它确保了数据控制、可重复性和可验证的输出，能够支持临床验证和工作流程集成。

articles.title: CircuitLens: Reasoning Circuits as Data Selection Signals for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is sensitive to which problems a model trains on, yet existing selection criteria--difficulty filtering, hand-curation, reward-trajectory scoring--assess data value as an intrinsic property of problems, independent of the model that will learn from them. We introduce Circuit Reasoning Score (CRS), a selection signal derived from 46 reasoning-sensitive attention heads identified via contrastive ablation, computed in a single forward pass on the frozen base model without reward labels or rollouts. CRS runs against the intuitive hypothesis that stronger reasoning-circuit engagement produces better training data: on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the lowest-engagement decile improves over random selection on three medium-difficulty benchmarks (GSM8K +2.0 pp, OlympiadBench +1.6 pp, Minerva +2.9 pp), while the highest-engagement decile gains less and is indistinguishable from the middle decile. The advantage has boundary conditions: on a domain-curated pool no selection method separates from the others; at 1.5B scale the useful direction differs; and the lowest-reward training condition produces the strongest downstream generalization. Within the Qwen2.5-Math settings tested, RLVR data selection appears regime-dependent rather than reducible to a static ranking of problem quality.
articles.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Findings. Long paper. 9 pages + references + appendix
articles.titleCn: CircuitLens：将推理电路作为数据选择信号，用于具有可验证奖励的强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）对模型训练的问题类型敏感，然而现有的选择标准——难度过滤、人工筛选、奖励轨迹评分——都将数据价值视为问题的内在属性，独立于从中学习的模型。我们引入电路推理分数（CRS），这是一种通过对比消融识别出的46个推理敏感注意力头导出的选择信号，在冻结的基础模型上单次前向传递计算，无需奖励标签或轨迹。CRS挑战了“更强的推理电路参与产生更好的训练数据”这一直观假设：在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，参与度最低的十分位数在三个中等难度基准（GSM8K +2.0 pp、OlympiadBench +1.6 pp、Minerva +2.9 pp）上优于随机选择，而参与度最高的十分位数提升较小且与中间十分位数无显著区别。这种优势存在边界条件：在领域筛选的数据集中没有选择方法能显著区分；在1.5B规模下有用方向不同；最低奖励训练条件产生了最强的下游泛化能力。在测试的Qwen2.5-Math设置中，RLVR数据选择似乎依赖于特定条件而非可简化为静态的问题质量排名。

articles.title: In-Place Instruction Following in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) generate text via bidirectional iterative denoising, naturally supporting user-specified constraints anchored at arbitrary output positions, a paradigm known as In-place Prompting (IPP). We formalize this as the In-place Instruction Following (IIF) task and construct IIF-Bench, a hierarchical benchmark spanning literal, style, and discourse-function constraints, paired with a rubric-based local-global evaluation protocol. An inference-time attention-bias probe suggests that vanilla dLLMs often under-prioritize constraint spans during denoising. We then propose GRAFT, an IPP-oriented post-training framework combining constraint-aware SFT and preference optimization. On four representative dLLMs, GRAFT raises the average IIF score from 57.75 to 73.10 (+15.35 points), with absolute gains of 15.91 and 15.57 points on literal and discourse-function constraints, while preserving general generation ability.
articles.titleCn: 扩散语言模型中的原位指令遵循
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）通过双向迭代去噪生成文本，自然地支持用户指定的约束，这些约束可以锚定在任意输出位置，这种范式被称为原位提示（IPP）。我们将此形式化为原位指令遵循（IIF）任务，并构建了IIF-Bench，这是一个涵盖字面、风格和话语功能约束的分层基准，并配备了基于评分的局部-全局评估协议。推理时的注意力偏差探测表明，普通的dLLMs在去噪过程中往往对约束跨度重视不足。随后，我们提出了GRAFT，这是一个面向IPP的微训练框架，结合了约束感知SFT和偏好优化。在四个代表性dLLMs上，GRAFT将平均IIF分数从57.75提高到73.10（+15.35分），在字面和话语功能约束上分别取得了15.91和15.57分的绝对增益，同时保留了泛化生成能力。

articles.title: FreqBLiMP: Frequency-Controlled Minimal Pairs Reveal Robustness and Fragility of LLMs Under Lexical Rarity
articles.abstract: Minimal-pair benchmarks such as BLiMP evaluate linguistic knowledge by testing whether language models (LMs) prefer acceptable sentences over minimally different unacceptable ones. However, these benchmarks largely ignore lexical frequency variation, despite lexical frequency being a pervasive and highly skewed property of natural language use. Consequently, existing evaluations do not test whether grammatical preferences remain stable when contrasts involve rare lexical items. We introduce FreqBLiMP, a frequency-controlled extension of BLiMP that regenerates all 67 paradigms under explicit Zipf-frequency regimes while preserving each minimal-pair's grammatical contrast. Evaluating multiple open-weight LLM families across scales, we find that decreasing lexical frequency produces a consistent, monotonic decrease in sentence likelihood, but only a modest reduction in overall contrastive acceptability accuracy. However, this aggregate stability masks substantial variation across linguistic phenomena, with LLMs remaining robust on overt morphosyntactic generalization while degrading on phenomena that require lemma-specific information.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Repo link: https://github.com/TimeTravelerTy/freqblimp-generation
articles.titleCn: FreqBLiMP：频率控制的极小对揭示在词汇罕见性下大型语言模型的鲁棒性和脆弱性
articles.abstractCn: 最小对基准测试，如BLiMP，通过测试语言模型（LMs）是否优先选择可接受的句子而非最小差异的不可接受句子来评估语言知识。然而，这些基准测试在很大程度上忽略了词汇频率的变化，尽管词汇频率是自然语言使用中普遍且高度偏斜的特性。因此，现有的评估并未测试当对比涉及罕见词汇项时，语法偏好是否保持稳定。我们引入FreqBLiMP，这是BLiMP的一个频率控制扩展，它在明确的齐夫频率制度下重新生成所有67种范式，同时保留每个最小对的语法对比。在跨规模评估多个开放权重的大型语言模型（LLMs）家族后，我们发现词汇频率降低会导致句子可能性呈现一致的单调下降，但整体对比接受度准确率仅略有降低。然而，这种总体稳定性掩盖了不同语言现象中的显著差异，LLMs在显式形态句法泛化上保持稳健，但在需要词元特定信息的现象上表现下降。

articles.title: Vishing-Tactics-Bench: Forecasting Exploitation Trajectories in Voice Phishing Calls
articles.abstract: Voice phishing (vishing) unfolds in real time; by the time a call has ended and post-hoc classification is possible, the harm has already been done. The more actionable question is which concrete harm (Information Gathering or Financial Exploitation) an ongoing call is tactically progressing toward. We present Vishing-Tactics-Bench, a benchmark grounded in Endsley's situation-awareness (SA) framework that recasts vishing defense from after-the-fact fraud classification to harm projection: predicting at each turn whether the call will reach either terminal harm. We adapt MITRE ATT&CK to vishing as a 6-tactic taxonomy (Vishing-Tactics) and label 35,340 scammer utterances across 5,645 synthetic Chinese calls. We define Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting, a survival-style protocol over the two terminal harms with three metrics: AP@k, C-index, and divergence error. Baselines ranging from a Markov heuristic to fine-tuned LLMs show that the tactical trajectory serves as an interpretable representation of the call's tactical state, supporting harm-specific forecasting, which can then be used for the downstream application of intervention selection; a stratified lead-time analysis at a tight false-alarm budget further identifies at what point in a call the trajectory signal yields early warning.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: 语音钓鱼呼叫中的攻击轨迹预测：Vishing-Tactics-Bench
articles.abstractCn: 语音诈骗（vishing）是实时发生的；当通话结束时，可以进行事后分类，但此时损害已经造成。更具可操作性的问题是，正在进行的通话在策略上正朝着哪种具体损害（信息收集或金融剥削）发展。我们提出了Vishing-Tactics-Bench，这是一个基于恩德利情境意识（SA）框架的基准，它将vishing防御从事后的欺诈分类转变为损害预测：在每一轮中预测通话是否会达到任何终端损害。我们将MITRE ATT&CK应用于vishing，作为一个包含6种策略的分类法（Vishing-Tactics），并对5,645个合成中文通话中的35,340个诈骗者话语进行了标注。我们定义了剥削轨迹预测，这是一种针对两种终端损害的生存式协议，包含三个指标：AP@k、C指数和发散误差。从马尔可夫启发式到微调的大型语言模型（LLMs）的基线表明，策略轨迹是通话策略状态的解释性表示，支持特定损害的预测，这随后可用于干预选择的下游应用；在严格的误报预算下进行的分层提前期分析进一步确定了通话中的哪个时刻，轨迹信号会发出早期预警。

articles.title: Encoded Early, Used Late: Where Transformers Begin to Act on an Inferred Partner's Expertise
articles.abstract: A transformer can make an attribute linearly decodable in its residual stream at a depth where that attribute does not yet influence the output. This gap between where information is readable and where it is used has been shown for attributes stated directly in the input. We ask whether it also holds for an attribute the model must infer gradually over a conversation, namely how expert its dialogue partner is. Using ExpertCollab, a corpus of multi-turn research-planning dialogues between model-played personas at four expertise levels, we find that partner expertise is most decodable in the early layers and falls to near chance before the midpoint of the network. Counterfactual patching shows that injecting the expertise difference at the layer of peak decodability barely changes a fixed late-layer readout, whereas the same difference injected past the midpoint propagates almost completely, a separation of more than an order of magnitude. A content-matched random control and a probe-free diagnostic place the transition at the same early layer, and a statically specified control attribute stays decodable throughout. An inferred relational attribute is therefore represented well before it becomes causally active, which bounds where any attempt to read out or steer partner-conditioned behavior must intervene. We use one model on a synthetic corpus as an initial demonstration.
articles.comment: Published at the Scientific Understanding of Foundation Models (Sci-FM) Workshop at COLM 2026
articles.titleCn: 编码早用晚：Transformer何时开始基于推断的伙伴专长行事
articles.abstractCn: Transformer可以在其残差流中使一个属性在深度上线性可解码，而此时该属性尚未影响输出。信息可读性与使用性之间的差距已被证明存在于直接陈述在输入中的属性。我们探究这种差距是否也适用于模型必须通过对话逐步推断的属性，即对话伙伴的专家程度。使用ExpertCollab，一个包含四层专家程度的研究规划多轮对话语料库，我们发现伙伴的专家程度在早期层最可解码，在网络的中间点之前降至接近随机水平。反事实修补表明，在可解码性峰值层注入专家差异几乎不改变固定的晚期读取输出，而相同差异在中间点之后注入则几乎完全传播，差异超过一个数量级。内容匹配的随机控制和无探测诊断将转换点置于相同的早期层，而静态指定的控制属性在整个过程中保持可解码。因此，推断的关系属性在成为因果活跃之前就被很好地表示，这界定了任何试图读取或引导伙伴条件行为的干预必须介入的位置。我们使用一个模型在一个合成语料库上进行初步演示。

articles.title: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble for Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction
articles.abstract: This paper presents our system for CCL2026-Eval Task 5: Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction (MGBIE), which jointly extracts 12 entity types and 6 relation types from minor-grain breeding literature. We propose RAME (Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble), a training-free framework that elicits multiple LLM outputs under controlled diversity and aggregates them by majority voting to obtain high-confidence predictions. RAME combines (i) retrieval-augmented few-shot selection via a hybrid BM25-embedding retriever, (ii) a three-prompt ensemble (Strict, Relaxed, Balanced) spanning the precision to recall spectrum, and (iii) large-scale repeated sampling with majority voting to filter noisy predictions. Built on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, RAME achieves a Total Score of 0.499 (NER 0.730, RE 0.346) on the leaderboard, ranking 1st and surpassing the official Track-A baseline powered by GPT-5.5 (0.448), representing an 11.4% relative improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/king-wang123/CCL26-RAME.
articles.comment: Accepted at CCL 2026 (China National Conference on Computational Linguistics)
articles.titleCn: 细粒度育种信息检索的检索增强多提示集成模型
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了我们在CCL2026-Eval任务5：细粒度育种信息抽取（MGBIE）中的系统，该系统从细粒度育种文献中联合抽取12种实体类型和6种关系类型。我们提出了RAME（检索增强多提示集成）这一无需训练的框架，在控制多样性的前提下激发多个大型语言模型（LLM）的输出，并通过多数投票进行聚合以获得高置信度预测。RAME结合了（i）通过混合BM25-嵌入检索器实现的检索增强式少样本选择，（ii）跨越精确率到召回率谱系的三个提示集成（严格、宽松、平衡），以及（iii）大规模重复采样与多数投票以过滤噪声预测。基于DeepSeek-V4-Flash构建的RAME在排行榜上取得了总分0.499的成绩（NER 0.730，RE 0.346），排名第一，超越了由GPT-5.5驱动的官方Track-A基线（0.448），实现了11.4%的相对提升。代码可在https://github.com/king-wang123/CCL26-RAME获取。

articles.title: Line-Coupled Language Model
articles.abstract: Autoregressive language models generate one token per decoding step, limiting the useful output of each forward pass. Although diffusion models, insertion-based decoding, and multi-token prediction enable parallel generation, they either incur additional training-time token traffic or struggle to predict strongly dependent future tokens. We introduce the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM), an autoregressive model that advances multiple text lines together by predicting the next token for every active line while coupling the lines through shared causal context. LCLM interleaves line tokens into a single causal sequence and uses line-staggered rotary positions, retaining the standard next-token objective and causal attention. Controlled experiments show that cross-line targets are substantially less dependent than consecutive same-line targets, supporting lines as parallel generation units. With 881M parameters, LCLM produces an average of 2.94 content tokens per forward pass with a validation cross-entropy loss of 2.44, compared with 1.00 token per forward pass and a loss of 2.39 for the vanilla autoregressive baseline. Most notably, even when LCLM generates 16 tokens per forward pass, its loss is only 0.09 higher than that of the vanilla autoregressive baseline (2.34 vs. 2.25).

articles.titleCn: 线耦合语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 自回归语言模型在解码的每一步生成一个标记，限制了每次前向传递的有用输出。尽管扩散模型、基于插入的解码和多标记预测能够并行生成，但它们要么导致额外的训练时间标记流量，要么难以预测强相关的未来标记。我们引入了线耦合语言模型（LCLM），这是一种自回归模型，通过预测每个活动行的下一个标记并通过共享因果上下文耦合行来一起推进多个文本行。LCLM将行标记交错到一个单一的因果序列中，并使用行交错旋转位置，保留了标准的下一个标记目标和因果注意力。受控实验表明，跨行目标比连续的同行目标依赖性要小得多，支持行作为并行生成单元。具有881M参数的LCLM，每次前向传递平均产生2.94个内容标记，验证交叉熵损失为2.44，而普通的自回归基线每次前向传递产生1.00个标记，损失为2.39。最值得注意的是，即使LCLM每次前向传递生成16个标记，其损失也仅比普通的自回归基线高0.09（2.34 vs. 2.25）。

articles.title: PTCG: Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation
articles.abstract: The ability to generate counterarguments is important for critical thinking and balanced discourse, yet existing approaches typically produce only a single counterargument, failing to capture the diversity and persuasiveness required in real-world debates. To address this limitation, we propose Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation (PTCG), a framework that combines Tree-of-Thoughts-inspired step-wise generation and pruning with speaker persona selection. By estimating the author's persona from the original argument and incorporating speaker personas representing distinct perspectives, PTCG operationalizes perspective-taking and enables the generation of diverse counterarguments. Results from LLM-as-a-Judge, classifier-based assessment, and human evaluations indicate that PTCG shows consistent improvements in both the diversity and persuasiveness of counterarguments compared to baseline methods.
articles.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 30 pages, 13 figures, 15 tables
articles.titleCn: PTCG：基于人格引导的树形反论生成
articles.abstractCn: 生成反驳论点的能力对于批判性思维和平衡的讨论至关重要，然而现有方法通常只能生成单一的反驳论点，无法捕捉现实辩论中所需的多样性和说服力。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了基于角色指导的树形反驳论点生成（PTCG）框架，该框架结合了受思维树启发的逐步生成与剪枝，以及说话人角色选择。通过从原始论点中估计作者的角色，并结合代表不同观点的说话人角色，PTCG实现了视角转换，并能够生成多样化的反驳论点。来自LLM作为评判者、基于分类器的评估以及人工评估的结果表明，与基线方法相比，PTCG在反驳论点的多样性和说服力方面均表现出持续改进。

articles.title: The Illusion of Debiasing: Persona Steering Redistributes Rather Than Reduces Bias in LLMs
articles.abstract: Prompt-based interventions: system prompts, personas, role instructions, reliably reshape what a language model says, but it is unclear which layer they reach. Do they reconfigure internal structure, or only modulate the output channel? We use persona conditioning as a controlled probe, measuring its effects along a depth axis from self-report, through open-ended generation, to word-level parametric association, across three instruction-tuned models. We find a graded dissociation. Personas are legible but not structural: models follow single-trait instructions yet fail to reproduce human inter-trait covariance. The dissociation deepens with depth: personas hold or amplify closed-form QA bias, shift absolute tone while leaving between-group disparity unchanged, and barely perturb an already saturated associative baseline. Prompt-based steering thus operates in the output channel and has a structural reach limit that surface manipulability can mask.
articles.titleCn: 偏见消除的幻象：角色引导重新分配而非减少大型语言模型的偏见
articles.abstractCn: 基于提示的干预措施：系统提示、角色设定、角色指令，能够可靠地重塑语言模型的输出，但其影响的层次尚不明确。它们是重配置了内部结构，还是仅仅调节了输出通道？我们以角色条件化为受控探针，测量其对从自我报告、开放式生成到词级参数关联的深度轴上的影响，跨越了三个指令调优模型。我们发现了一种渐变的分离现象。角色设定是可读的但非结构性：模型遵循单一特质指令，却无法再现人类跨特质的协方差。分离现象随深度加深：角色设定维持或放大了封闭式问答偏见，改变了绝对语气但未改变群体间的差异，且几乎未扰动已饱和的关联基线。基于提示的引导操作作用于输出通道，并具有结构影响的极限，表面可操控性可能掩盖了这一极限。

articles.title: Revisiting Complete Reasoning Traces for Post-Training
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often post-trained on pre-collected reasoning trajectories to improve their reasoning capability. Such trajectories tend to be long due to complex, interwoven paths, which often include detours on the path toward the answer. However, it has been underexplored whether LLMs indeed benefit from learning complete trajectories in post-training, such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Starting from our pilot study, we find that full trajectories provide only limited benefit, while partial trajectories are effective even under heavy truncation. We analyze redundancy in reasoning trajectories through attention-based analyses and controlled token-removal studies, both of which show that intermediate tokens contribute minimally to final reasoning quality. This suggests that avoiding redundant information may allow LLMs to internally infer coherent alternatives by inferring missing steps from their internal knowledge, given known trajectory endpoints. Furthermore, we show that training LLMs using endpoints leads to consistent changes in reasoning behavior, and that it also benefits post-training methods based on reinforcement learning or on-policy distillation, highlighting the need to revisit complete reasoning traces. Code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/revisiting-trace.
articles.comment: To appear in EMNLP 2026 Findings
articles.titleCn: 重新审视训练后的完整推理轨迹
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常通过在预先收集的推理轨迹上进行后训练来提升其推理能力。这些轨迹往往因为路径复杂且交织而显得很长，通常包含通往答案过程中的迂回路径。然而，LLMs是否确实能从后训练中学习完整轨迹（如监督微调SFT）的问题尚未得到充分探索。从我们的初步研究开始，我们发现完整轨迹提供的益处有限，而部分轨迹即使在严重截断的情况下也依然有效。我们通过基于注意力的分析和受控的token移除研究，分析了推理轨迹中的冗余性，两者均表明中间token对最终推理质量贡献甚微。这表明，避免冗余信息可能允许LLMs通过从其内部知识中推断缺失步骤，在已知轨迹端点的情况下，内部推断出连贯的替代方案。此外，我们展示了使用端点训练LLMs会导致推理行为的持续变化，并且这也使基于强化学习或在线蒸馏的后训练方法受益，突显了重新审视完整推理轨迹的必要性。代码可在https://github.com/naver-ai/revisiting-trace获取。

articles.title: Risk Is Not Review Value: Wrong-Answer Exposure Under Bounded Review Budgets
articles.abstract: LLM assistants often produce more answers than humans can review before users see them. Most evaluations ask whether an answer is wrong, unsupported, or low-confidence. Bounded review budgets instead ask which answers should be checked first under a fixed review budget. Risk alone is not enough: a high-risk answer may be hard to repair, while a moderately risky answer may be directly correctable from available evidence. For generated-answer evaluation, we model review prioritization as exposure reduction, where review value combines estimated wrongness, intervention affordance, impact, and cost. We evaluate review queues with Wrong-Answer Exposure Ratio (WAER), the fraction of wrong answers left unreviewed, and post-repair residual exposure (PRRE), the fraction still exposed after deterministic benchmark-supported repairs. PRRE uses repairability rules that do not numerically reuse the affordance scores used for ranking. On a 720-item TAT-QA/SciFact stress benchmark, review-value ranking keeps answer-level WAER nearly unchanged at 20% budget (0.605 vs. 0.600) but lowers PRRE from 0.881 to 0.716. These results show that trustworthy LLM evaluation should measure not only error detection, but also how limited review capacity reduces exposed wrong answers.
articles.comment: Accepted at SeT-LLM 2026 Workshop, KDD 2026
articles.titleCn: 风险并非评审价值：有限评审预算下的错误答案暴露
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型助手通常会产生比人类在用户看到之前能够审查的更多答案。大多数评估方法询问答案是否错误、缺乏支持或置信度低。而受预算限制的审查方法则询问在固定审查预算下应优先检查哪些答案。仅凭风险是不够的：高风险答案可能难以修复，而中等风险答案则可能直接通过现有证据进行纠正。在生成答案评估中，我们将审查优先级建模为风险暴露减少，其中审查价值结合了估计的错误程度、干预可能性、影响和成本。我们使用错误答案暴露率（WAER）和修复后残余暴露（PRRE）来评估审查队列，WAER是未审查的错误答案比例，PRRE是在确定性基准支持修复后仍暴露的错误答案比例。PRRE使用不重复用于排序的干预可能性分数的修复规则。在一个包含720个项目的TAT-QA/SciFact压力基准上，审查价值排序在20%的预算下使答案级别的WAER几乎保持不变（0.605 vs. 0.600），但将PRRE从0.881降低到0.716。这些结果表明，可信的大型语言模型评估不仅应测量错误检测，还应衡量有限的审查能力如何减少暴露的错误答案。

articles.title: Where to Look and What to Use: Retrieve-Localize-Generate for Long-Term Conversational Memory Question Answering
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to answer questions by accessing external knowledge and has been widely adopted for long-term conversational memory question answering. However, existing methods suffer from two key challenges: (1) fragmented evidence scattered across temporally distant sessions, and (2) noisy content within retrieved sessions that triggers the lost-in-the-middle effect. To address these challenges, we propose MemLoc, a unified Retrieve-Localize-Generate framework for long-term conversational memory QA. For retrieval, MemLoc decomposes each session into multi-granularity memory units and performs query routing via an inner-memory graph with entropy-based granularity selection. It further models cross-session semantic and temporal dependencies through a cross-memory graph, enabling coarse-to-fine retrieval of top-K relevant memory candidates. For localization, we introduce a reasoning-based evidence locator trained with Self-reflective Hint Policy Optimization (SHPO), which performs progressive refinement by extracting query-relevant fragments within memory units to suppress noise and reranking across candidates to remove redundancy, producing a compact evidence set with lightweight location IDs. For generation, these IDs act as precise grounding signals that guide the LLM to the correct memory positions, mitigating the lost-in-the-middle effect while preserving original contextual integrity. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that MemLoc achieves state-of-the-art retrieval accuracy and response quality while maintaining efficiency. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Nikol-coder/MemLoc.

articles.titleCn: 寻找之处与使用之物：用于长期对话记忆问答的检索-定位-生成
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）使大型语言模型（LLM）能够通过访问外部知识来回答问题，并已广泛应用于长期对话记忆问答。然而，现有方法存在两个关键挑战：（1）分散在时间上遥远的会话中的碎片化证据；（2）检索会话中的噪声内容，这会引发“中间丢失”效应。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了MemLoc，一个用于长期对话记忆问答的统一检索-定位-生成框架。在检索方面，MemLoc将每个会话分解为多粒度记忆单元，并通过基于熵的粒度选择的内记忆图进行查询路由。它进一步通过跨记忆图对跨会话的语义和时间依赖关系进行建模，实现相关记忆候选的粗到精检索。在定位方面，我们引入了一个基于推理的证据定位器，该定位器使用自我反思提示策略优化（SHPO）进行训练，通过提取记忆单元内的与查询相关的片段来逐步细化，以抑制噪声并在候选中进行重新排序以消除冗余，生成具有轻量级位置ID的紧凑证据集。在生成方面，这些ID作为精确的接地信号，指导LLM到达正确的记忆位置，从而减轻“中间丢失”效应，同时保持原始上下文的完整性。在四个基准测试上的大量实验表明，MemLoc实现了最先进的检索准确性和响应质量，同时保持了效率。我们的代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/Nikol-coder/MemLoc。

articles.title: Comparing Self-Supervised and Domain-Invariant Features for Cross-Domain Voice Phishing Detection
articles.abstract: Voice phishing detection faces three critical challenges: real criminal recordings are unavailable due to privacy constraints; when available, only a handful of samples exist, insufficient for fine-tuning; and lightweight acoustic-only detection is needed as an alternative to large self-supervised models. We compare domain-invariant prosodic features and self-supervised representations (HuBERT, wav2vec2.0) through cross-domain evaluation-training on scenario-based actor recordings and testing on authentic criminal calls. Domain-invariant prosodic features achieve 69.5% F1 zero-shot and 71.0% with 5-shot learning. HuBERT achieves highest performance (94.2% F1, 5-shot), while wav2vec2.0 exhibits a precision-oriented detection profile (90.2% F1 with 99.4% precision, 5-shot). These findings reveal fundamental trade-offs: domain-invariant features enable zero-shot deployment when no real data exists, while SSL methods achieve higher performance but require real samples and compute.
articles.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at INTERSPEECH 2026
articles.titleCn: 比较自监督和领域不变特征在跨域语音钓鱼检测中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 语音诈骗检测面临三大关键挑战：由于隐私限制，真实犯罪录音无法获取；即便获取，样本数量稀少，不足以进行精细调优；同时需要轻量级的纯声学检测作为大型自监督模型的替代方案。我们通过跨域评估-训练（基于场景的演员录音）和真实犯罪电话测试，比较了领域不变韵律特征与自监督表示（HuBERT、wav2vec2.0）。领域不变韵律特征实现了69.5%的零样本F1值和71.0%的5样本学习F1值。HuBERT表现最佳（5样本时F1值达94.2%），而wav2vec2.0展现出以精确度为导向的检测特征（5样本时F1值为90.2%，精确度达99.4%）。这些发现揭示了根本性的权衡：领域不变特征在无真实数据时支持零样本部署，而SSL方法虽能实现更高性能，但需要真实样本和计算资源。

articles.title: A Hyperbolicity Atlas of Large Language Model Hidden States
articles.abstract: LLM hidden states are ordinary vectors, but the distances among those vectors may still show hierarchical structure. To our knowledge, this paper is the first systematic study of whether prompt-token hidden states in contemporary LLMs exhibit Gromov Hyperbolicity (GH), a distance-based measure of tree-likeness. Using 818,904 sample-layer measurements from ten open-weight models across MATH500, HumanEval, WinoGrande, and TruthfulQA, we build a GH map over four axes: parameter scale, layer depth, model family, and input domain. The clearest pattern is depth, not scale: middle layers usually form a high-relative-hyperbolicity plateau, while final layers often become substantially more tree-like. Scale effects are weak and non-monotonic, matched 7/8B model families differ strongly, and domains interact with model specialization. These findings make GH useful as a practical diagnostic: it shows where hierarchical distance structure appears, how specialization changes it, and which model-layer-domain comparisons deserve closer analysis.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型隐藏状态的超曲率图谱
articles.abstractCn: LLM的隐藏状态是普通的向量，但这些向量之间的距离可能仍然显示出层次结构。据我们所知，本文首次系统地研究了当代LLM中的提示标记隐藏状态是否表现出Gromov超平面性（GH），这是一种基于距离的树状结构度量。我们使用来自MATH500、HumanEval、WinoGrande和TruthfulQA的十个开放权重模型的81万8千9百零四个样本层测量数据，在参数规模、层深度、模型家族和输入域四个轴上构建了一个GH图谱。最明显的模式是深度而非规模：中间层通常形成一个高相对超平面性的平台，而最终层往往变得显著更像树状结构。规模效应较弱且非单调，7/8B模型家族差异巨大，领域与模型专业化相互作用。这些发现使GH成为一项实用的诊断工具：它显示了层次距离结构出现的位置，专业化如何改变它，以及哪些模型-层-域比较值得进一步分析。

articles.title: Aha-Flow Distillation: Flow Markers Matter in LLM Reasoning
articles.abstract: We identify the Flow Moment, a reasoning pattern characterized by sustained, process-confirming verbalizations such as I'm doing, in contrast to the revision- and backtracking-oriented Aha Moment. We refer to their corresponding linguistic expressions as Flow Markers and Aha Markers, respectively. Based on this observation, we construct Flow-CoT by rewriting the discourse markers of original reasoning traces while preserving their underlying reasoning content, and use it as auxiliary supervision for on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). We further propose \textbf{Aha-Flow Distillation (AFD)}, a dual-mode extension of OPSD that pairs different forms of privileged information with corresponding reasoning instructions. The Aha branch retains concise solution-based supervision, while the Flow branch introduces rewritten Flow-CoT under a direct and confident reasoning instruction. At inference time, the model uses only the standard reflective instruction, so Flow-style reasoning serves purely as a training signal. Experiments on AIME25 and HMMT25 show consistent improvements across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B: AFD improves Avg@12 from 60.8 to 61.3 on Qwen3-8B and from 57.5 to 58.6 on Qwen3-4B over our reproduced OPSD baselines. Controlled ablations further show that, with the same Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT composition, dual-mode training improves Avg@12 from 59.5 to 60.1, indicating that the benefit comes not only from introducing heterogeneous reasoning supervision, but also from how it is organized during self-distillation. The code is available at https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/Aha-Flow-Distillation.

articles.titleCn: Aha-Flow蒸馏：流标记在大型语言模型推理中至关重要
articles.abstractCn: 我们识别出了一种名为"Flow Moment"的推理模式，其特征是持续的、符合过程的语言化表达，如"I'm doing"，与以修正和回溯为特征的"Aha Moment"形成对比。我们将它们相应的语言表达分别称为Flow标记和Aha标记。基于这一观察，我们通过重写原始推理轨迹中的话语标记，同时保留其底层推理内容，构建了Flow-CoT，并将其用作策略自蒸馏（OPSD）的辅助监督。我们进一步提出了\textbf{Aha-Flow蒸馏（AFD）}，这是OPSD的一种双模式扩展，将不同形式的特权信息与相应的推理指令相匹配。Aha分支保留简洁的基于解决方案的监督，而Flow分支在直接且自信的推理指令下引入重写的Flow-CoT。在推理时，模型仅使用标准的反思指令，因此Flow风格的推理纯粹作为训练信号。在AIME25和HMMT25上的实验显示，在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-4B上均取得了持续改进：AFD在Qwen3-8B上将Avg@12从60.8提升至61.3，在Qwen3-4B上从57.5提升至58.6，超过了我们复现的OPSD基线。受控消融实验进一步表明，使用相同的Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT组合，双模式训练将Avg@12从59.5提升至60.1，这表明其优势不仅来自于引入异构推理监督，还来自于自蒸馏过程中这种组织方式。代码可在https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/Aha-Flow-Distillation获取。

articles.title: LatentMD: Benchmarking Markdown Boundary Failures in LLM-Generated Text
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate Markdown that is consumed by renderers, agents, code extractors, and structured downstream pipelines. Yet existing evaluations often conflate content quality with format adherence, leaving Markdown boundary failures under-measured. We introduce LatentMD, a benchmark and evaluation protocol for diagnosing CommonMark-level fence-boundary failures in LLM-generated Markdown. LatentMD separates content correctness from boundary correctness, enabling detection of outputs that are content-correct but boundary-broken. The benchmark contains 4,179 prompts and a CLI for scoring arbitrary model outputs. Across 9 LLMs and roughly 37,600 generations, we find that Markdown boundary failures are widespread: 38.0% of valid main-grid outputs are content-correct but boundary-broken, with substantial boundary breakage under unspecified prompts and in a small human-authored validation set. Ablations show that failures are driven primarily by same-family symmetric-delimiter collisions rather than nesting alone, are only partially mitigated by prompt hints, and generalize to Python triple-quote docstrings while JSON remains robust as an asymmetric-delimiter control. LatentMD provides a reproducible diagnostic target for parser-sensitive LLM evaluation.
articles.titleCn: LatentMD：对LLM生成文本中的Markdown边界错误进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地生成Markdown，这些Markdown被渲染器、代理、代码提取器和结构化下游管道所消费。然而，现有的评估常常将内容质量与格式遵循混淆，导致Markdown边界失败被低估。我们引入了LatentMD，这是一个用于诊断LLM生成的Markdown中CommonMark级围栏边界失败的基准和评估协议。LatentMD将内容正确性与边界正确性分离，能够检测出内容正确但边界错误的输出。该基准包含4,179个提示，并提供了一个用于评分任意模型输出的命令行界面。在9个LLMs和约37,600次生成中，我们发现Markdown边界失败普遍存在：38.0%的有效主网格输出内容正确但边界错误，在未指定提示和一小部分人类编写的验证集中存在大量边界错误。消融实验表明，这些失败主要由同族对称分隔符冲突驱动，而非仅由嵌套引起，提示信息只能部分缓解这些问题，并且这些问题会泛化到Python三引号文档字符串，而JSON作为非对称分隔符控制则保持稳健。LatentMD为对解析器敏感的LLM评估提供了一个可重复的诊断目标。

articles.title: Train Overcomplete, Deploy Compact: Scaling Recovery Capacity for Structured LLM Pruning
articles.abstract: Large language models achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, but deployment remains costly because of memory, latency, and energy demands. Structured pruning reduces these costs by removing architectural components, yet its recovery stage is often limited by a mismatch between the recovery module's representational capacity and the complexity of the removed knowledge. We call this bottleneck the capacity-knowledge asymmetry and propose OverRep, an Overcomplete Reparameterization framework for structured LLM pruning. Following the principle of "train overcomplete, deploy compact", OverRep temporarily overparameterizes the recovery module during training to absorb complex knowledge distilled from the original model. After recovery, the overcomplete re-parameterization is algebraically merged into a mathematically equivalent compact module, preserving the pruned model's inference-time architecture and computational cost. OverRep further introduces an annealed activation that enables nonlinear training dynamics while converging to a linear regime for exact algebraic merging. Across three backbone families, OverRep improves retained reasoning performance over strong recovery baselines by up to 5.5 and 8.4 points at 25% and 50% pruning, respectively, while keeping memory usage and TFLOPs comparable to existing recovery methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/mmai-laboratory/OverRep.
