articles.titleCn: 训练过完备，部署紧凑：为结构化LLM剪枝扩展恢复能力
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在多样化任务中表现出色，但部署成本高昂，这主要源于内存、延迟和能耗需求。结构化剪枝通过移除架构组件来降低这些成本，然而其恢复阶段常受限于恢复模块的表征能力与被移除知识复杂度之间的不匹配。我们将此瓶颈称为容量-知识不对称性，并提出了一种名为OverRep的Overcomplete Reparameterization框架，用于结构化LLM剪枝。遵循“训练冗余，部署紧凑”的原则，OverRep在训练期间暂时对恢复模块进行冗余参数化，以吸收从原始模型中提炼出的复杂知识。恢复后，冗余重参数化通过代数方法与一个数学等价的紧凑模块合并，从而保留剪枝模型的推理时架构和计算成本。OverRep进一步引入了一种退火激活函数，在收敛到线性域以实现精确代数合并的同时，实现了非线性训练动态。在三个骨干家族上，OverRep在25%和50%剪枝率下，相较于强恢复基线，分别将保留的推理性能提升了5.5和8.4个百分点，同时内存使用和TFLOPs与现有恢复方法相当。我们的代码可在https://github.com/mmai-laboratory/OverRep获取。

articles.title: CantoneseLLM v2: Reasoning in a Low-Resource Language
articles.abstract: Cantonese is widely spoken but remains low-resource in written data, with no large corpus of native Cantonese reasoning traces available for model training. We develop and release CantoneseLLM v2, comprising models based on Qwen3 8B and 30B-A3B. The models are trained through CPT on 784 million Cantonese and Hong Kong-related tokens, chat-vector merging, SFT, DPO, and RLVR. Evaluation across the training stages shows that chat-vector merging transfers instruction following but preserves the donor model's reasoning language, while SFT with limited Cantonese reasoning data substantially shortens or removes reasoning traces and reduces benchmark performance. DPO restores the reasoning-block format, particularly for the 8B model, but recovers only part of the lost performance. The RLVR training with Cantonese language and Traditional Chinese scripts as multiplicative constraints introduced Cantonese language alignment and restored the lost performance. The 30B-A3B model reaches 73.16 on HKCanto-Eval, within 1.20 points of its merged checkpoint, while retaining the Cantonese reasoning behaviour absent from that checkpoint. We release the model checkpoints, the training environments, and a thirteen-year Traditional Chinese Common Crawl dataset. The models can be accessed at https://huggingface.co/collections/hon9kon9ize/cantonesellm-v20
articles.titleCn: 粤语LLM v2：低资源语言的推理
articles.abstractCn: 粤语虽然广泛使用，但在书面数据资源方面仍然匮乏，目前没有可用于模型训练的大规模粤语推理轨迹语料库。我们开发并发布了粤语LLM v2，该版本包含基于Qwen3 8B和30B-A3B的模型。这些模型通过CPT、聊天向量合并、SFT、DPO和RLVR等技术在7.84亿个粤语及香港相关token上进行训练。各训练阶段的评估表明，聊天向量合并能够传递指令遵循能力，但保留了供体模型的推理语言；而使用有限的粤语推理数据进行SFT训练，则大幅缩短或移除了推理轨迹，并降低了基准性能。DPO恢复了推理块格式，尤其对8B模型而言，但仅部分恢复了丢失的性能。使用粤语语言和繁体中文作为乘性约束的RLVR训练，引入了粤语语言对齐并恢复了丢失的性能。30B-A3B模型在HKCanto-Eval上达到了73.16分，与合并检查点仅相差1.20分，同时保留了合并检查点中缺失的粤语推理行为。我们发布了模型检查点、训练环境和一个包含十三年数据的繁体中文通用爬取数据集。这些模型可通过https://huggingface.co/collections/hon9kon9ize/cantonesellm-v20获取。

articles.title: MOLE: Detecting Insider Threats in AI Agents
articles.abstract: Model misalignment, prompt injection, or operator misuse could lead AI agents operating frontier-lab accounts to exfiltrate model weights, poison training data, or weaken release gates. Existing benchmarks do not test whether defenders can detect this activity among routine work under a limited review budget. We introduce MOLE, an open benchmark of 150 AI-operated accounts sharing 9 stateful services over 30 workdays, with 12 threats and 8 corpora from four models totaling roughly 20 billion tokens. Of 39 agent models, 72% complete most assigned harmful objectives and agent refusal does not predict completion. MOLE enables comparison of 40 monitors across corpus generators, observability levels, and threats; even the best evaluated monitor in our single-day audit-event comparison misses nearly half of completed harm. MOLE also enables monitor development: benchmark-guided search improves a mid-tier monitor by 49-64%, while selective use of a stronger monitor improves budget-AUC by 10% over applying it to every account-day at comparable modeled cost.
articles.titleCn: MOLE：检测人工智能代理中的内部威胁
articles.abstractCn: 模型错位、提示注入或操作员误用可能导致在前沿实验室账户下运行的 AI 代理窃取模型权重、污染训练数据或削弱发布门槛。现有的基准测试并未在有限的审查预算下测试防御者能否检测到此类活动。我们引入了 MOLE，这是一个开放的基准测试，包含 150 个由 AI 操作的账户，在 30 个工作日内共享 9 个有状态服务，涵盖 12 种威胁和来自四个模型的 8 个语料库，总计约 200 亿个标记。在 39 个代理模型中，72% 完成了大部分分配的有害目标，而代理拒绝并不能预测完成情况。MOLE 能够在语料库生成器、可观察性级别和威胁之间比较 40 个监控器；在我们的单日审计事件比较中，最佳评估监控器仍会遗漏近一半已完成的有害行为。MOLE 还支持监控器开发：基准指导的搜索将一个中档监控器的性能提升了 49-64%，而选择性地使用一个更强的监控器，在可比的建模成本下，将预算-AUC 提高了 10%。

articles.title: TurEngMix: A Text Corpus and Benchmark for Turkish-English Code-Mixed Language Identification and Named Entity Recognition
articles.abstract: Natural language processing systems underperform on code-mixed text, particularly for low-resource language pairs. Turkish-English poses a further challenge: it lets English stems combine with Turkish suffixes to form single mixed-language tokens. We introduce TurEngMix, a corpus of 5.5K noisy, naturally occurring social media posts (486,974 tokens) rich in Turkish-English code-mixing. From this corpus, we construct a new Turkish-English benchmark for code-mixed language identification (LID) and named entity recognition (NER), comprising 15K expert-annotated tokens. Evaluating both decoder LLM and fine-tuned encoder baselines, we find that monolingual Turkish and English tokens are labeled reliably, but all models have high error rates on mixed-language tokens for both LID and NER. For morphologically integrated tokens, NER error rates were 5.2x and 6.3x higher for GPT-4o and Qwen, respectively. This highlights how morphological integration remains a challenge. We release the corpus, annotations, and code to support future computational and sociolinguistic research on Turkish-English code-mixing.
articles.comment: Accepted to W-NUT 2026 (11th Workshop on Natural User-generated Text), co-located with EMNLP 2026. 15 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables
articles.titleCn: TurEngMix：用于土耳其-英语混合语言识别和命名实体识别的文本语料库与基准
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言处理系统在混合语言文本上的表现不佳，尤其是在低资源语言对中。土耳其-英语混合语言提出了进一步的挑战：它允许英语词干与土耳其后缀结合形成单个混合语言标记。我们介绍了TurEngMix，一个包含5.5K个噪声、自然出现的社交媒体帖子（486,974个标记）的语料库，其中富含土耳其-英语混合语言。从该语料库中，我们构建了一个新的土耳其-英语基准，用于混合语言识别（LID）和命名实体识别（NER），包含15K个专家标注的标记。评估解码器LLM和微调编码器基线模型后，我们发现单语土耳其和英语标记能够可靠地标注，但所有模型在LID和NER任务上对混合语言标记的错误率都很高。对于形态整合标记，GPT-4o和Qwen的NER错误率分别高出5.2倍和6.3倍。这突显了形态整合仍然是一个挑战。我们发布了语料库、标注代码，以支持未来关于土耳其-英语混合语言的计算和社会语言学研究。

articles.title: Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE and Empirical Analysis of Vocabulary Pruning
articles.abstract: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but the resulting merge order does not necessarily allocate a fixed model-visible vocabulary optimally for compression. We propose Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE (DH-BPE), a vocabulary-construction method that combines token exposure under exact minimum-token segmentation with the hierarchical dependencies induced by BPE training. Starting from a modestly overshot BPE candidate vocabulary, DH-BPE uses dynamic programming to measure candidate utility and applies exposure-guided, dependency-aware pruning to select a fixed-size model-visible vocabulary. We compare DH-BPE against Standard BPE and recent vocabulary-optimization baselines, including Pruned BPE, MinGram, and MinGram-PP, in primary evaluations at 12K and 16K target vocabulary sizes, with an additional 18K evaluation against MinGram only. Across the primary 12K and 16K comparisons, DH-BPE consistently improves aggregate compression over Standard BPE, Pruned BPE, and MinGram under a shared exact minimum-token DP encoder. MinGram-PP achieves stronger aggregate compression in the primary comparisons, but DH-BPE outperforms it at overshoot factors f = 2.0 and f = 3.0 in cross-corpus evaluation; at 12K, MinGram-PP reverses this ordering only with the substantially larger candidate pools at f = 4.0 and f = 5.0. Qualitative analysis further shows that DH-BPE balances later, more complete BPE merges with reusable subword components, providing a practical approach to improving vocabulary allocation under a fixed model-visible vocabulary budget.
articles.comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, and 1 algorithm
articles.titleCn: 动态规划引导的层级BPE及其词汇剪枝的实证分析
articles.abstractCn: 字节对编码（BPE）通过贪婪配对合并构建词汇表，但生成的合并顺序不一定为压缩优化地分配一个固定的模型可见词汇。我们提出了动态规划引导的分层BPE（DH-BPE），这是一种结合了精确最小词分割下的标记曝光和由BPE训练产生的分层依赖关系的词汇构建方法。从适度超量的BPE候选词汇表开始，DH-BPE使用动态规划来衡量候选效用，并应用曝光引导、依赖感知的剪枝来选择固定大小的模型可见词汇。我们在12K和16K目标词汇大小下对DH-BPE与标准BPE以及最近的词汇优化基线方法（包括剪枝BPE、MinGram和MinGram-PP）进行了主要评估，并额外对MinGram进行了18K的评估。在主要的12K和16K比较中，DH-BPE在共享的精确最小词DP编码器下始终比标准BPE、剪枝BPE和MinGram的总体压缩效果更好。MinGram-PP在主要比较中实现了更强的总体压缩效果，但在跨语料库评估中，DH-BPE在超量因子f=2.0和f=3.0时表现更优；在12K时，MinGram-PP仅在f=4.0和f=5.0的显著更大的候选池中逆转了这一顺序。定性分析进一步表明，DH-BPE平衡了后期更完整的BPE合并和可重用的子词组件，为在固定模型可见词汇预算下改进词汇分配提供了一种实用方法。

articles.title: Towards Bridging the Gap Between Offline and Iterative Alignment via Preference Distillation
articles.abstract: Direct preference optimization DPO is a promising offline approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) due to its simplicity, computational efficiency, and implicit modeling of human preferences. Interestingly, iterative extensions of DPO have achieved stronger performance on academic benchmarks, raising two key questions: (i) Why do iterative methods generally outperform offline ones? (ii) Can their advantages be incorporated into offline alignment? To answer the first question, our controlled experiments reveal that the explicit preference model, additionally introduced in the iterative procedure, is a key factor behind its superiority over offline methods. This insight leads us to answer the second question affirmatively and propose Distilled Preference Probability Policy Optimization (DP3O), an effective and efficient offline alignment algorithm. DP3O first learns an explicit preference model using a helper class of LLMs and then distills its knowledge into policy optimization. Theoretically, we show that explicit preference modeling admits better estimation error control than implicit formulations, and that DP3O achieves a tighter generalization bound than hard-label DPO through variance reduction. Empirically, we evaluate DP3O on a wide range of chat-based and downstream tasks and show that it outperforms state-of-the-art offline methods, achieves performance comparable to iterative DPO, and reduces training time by about $42\%$, demonstrating both its effectiveness and efficiency.
articles.comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
articles.titleCn: 通过偏好蒸馏弥合离线与迭代对齐之间的差距
articles.abstractCn: 直接偏好优化（DPO）是一种因其简单性、计算效率和隐式模拟人类偏好的优势而备受期待的离线方法，用于对齐大型语言模型（LLM）。有趣的是，DPO的迭代扩展在学术基准测试中取得了更强的性能，引发了两个关键问题：（i）为什么迭代方法通常优于离线方法？（ii）它们的优势能否融入离线对齐？为回答第一个问题，我们的受控实验表明，迭代过程中额外引入的显式偏好模型是其优于离线方法的关键因素。这一见解使我们能够肯定地回答第二个问题，并提出了蒸馏偏好概率策略优化（DP3O），这是一种有效且高效的离线对齐算法。DP3O首先使用一组辅助LLM学习一个显式偏好模型，然后将该模型的知识蒸馏到策略优化中。理论上，我们证明了显式偏好建模比隐式公式具有更好的估计误差控制能力，并且DP3O通过方差减少实现了比硬标签DPO更紧的泛化界限。实证上，我们在广泛的基于聊天和下游任务上评估了DP3O，并证明它优于最先进的离线方法，实现了与迭代DPO相当的性能，并将训练时间减少了约42%，展示了其有效性和效率。

articles.title: Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Reasoning over language instructions in embodied tasks such as robotics often requires understanding spatial relations from a speaker's situated perspective. Humans infer such perspectives from shared environmental knowledge, activity context, and commonsense. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) appear capable of spatial reasoning, but their ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and interpret situated spatial relations from that viewpoint remains unclear. We call this capability contextual observer grounding. To study this capability, we construct the Point-of-View Benchmark (POVBench), a dataset of 3D scenes and queries that disentangles Inferred, Stated, and Given forms of observer grounding in natural embodied communication. Given multi-view observations and a natural-language sentence, models must localize unseen or underspecified targets from situated spatial and contextual cues. Across state-of-the-art VLMs, localizing targets from directional language remains challenging, even when observer grounding is made explicit. We find that explicit breakdowns of observer-relative spatial reasoning improve target localization. Our project page is available at https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings
articles.titleCn: 情境观察者定位：评估视觉语言模型中的情境空间推理
articles.abstractCn: 在机器人等具身任务中，对语言指令进行推理通常需要从说话者的位置视角理解空间关系。人类通过共享的环境知识、活动背景和常识来推断这种视角。最近，视觉语言模型（VLMs）似乎具备空间推理能力，但它们从上下文线索中推断说话者视角以及从该视角解释具身空间关系的能力尚不明确。我们将这种能力称为上下文观察者基础。为了研究这种能力，我们构建了视角基准（POVBench），这是一个包含3D场景和查询的数据集，它将自然具身交流中推断的、陈述的和给定的观察者基础形式解耦。给定多视角观察和自然语言句子，模型必须从具身的空间和上下文线索中定位未出现或未明确指定的目标。在当前最先进的VLMs中，即使观察者基础被明确说明，从方向性语言中定位目标仍然具有挑战性。我们发现，明确的观察者相对空间推理分解可以提高目标定位的准确性。我们的项目页面可在 https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/ 访问。
